Divisions.Battlegroup.AddCard.Tip.text: 向战斗群添加一张此类卡片

Divisions.Battlegroup.AddCard.Pick.text: 点击一个单位以添加其卡牌。

Divisions.Battlegroup.TakeOut.Tip.text: 将此卡片从战斗群中移出

Divisions.Battlegroup.Transport.Tip.text: 位于{transport}中。点击以选择另一辆运输车

Divisions.Battlegroup.Transport.None.Tip.english: No transport. Click to choose one
Divisions.Battlegroup.Transport.None.Tip.text: 无运输工具。点击选择一个

Divisions.Battlegroup.Revert.Tip.english: Takes back the mod's changes to this battlegroup
Divisions.Battlegroup.Revert.Tip.text: 撤销模组对此作战群所做的更改

Divisions.Battlegroup.Changed.Tip.text: 在{mod}中已更改：该游戏拥有{cards}张卡牌

Divisions.Battlegroup.Of.Tip.text: 在“师”子选项卡中打开该师

Divisions.Battlegroup.TypeCount.Tip.english: Cards of this type, and how many the division has room for
Divisions.Battlegroup.TypeCount.Tip.text: 此类卡牌，以及该师可容纳的数量

Divisions.Battlegroup.NotForThisGame.english: Battlegroups are WARNO's; {game} has none in its files.
Divisions.Battlegroup.NotForThisGame.text: 战斗群属于WARNO；{game}的文件中没有战斗群。

Divisions.Battlegroup.Footnote.english: Click a card to see its unit in the Unit pane. Drag a card to change the order, as the game shows it. + adds a card; × takes one out.
Divisions.Battlegroup.Footnote.text: 点击卡片可在“单位”窗格中查看其所属单位。拖动卡片可按游戏显示的顺序调整排列顺序。“+”添加卡片；“×”移除一张。

Divisions.Battlegroup.CardNumber.Tip.english: Number in the game's files: {number} (the game's own cards have 1)
Divisions.Battlegroup.CardNumber.Tip.text: 游戏文件中的数量：{number}（游戏自带卡牌数量为1）

Divisions.Battlegroup.Problem.UnitUnknow.text: {unit}：源文件中不存在此单位。如果模组添加了该单位，请在“文件”选项卡中添加 {file}，以便 军械库对其应用模组的规则。

Divisions.Battlegroup.Problem.UnitsUnkno.english: {count} units of these cards are not in the source ({units}). If a mod adds them, put {file} on the Files tab so the Armory runs the mod's rules on it.
Divisions.Battlegroup.Problem.UnitsUnkno.text: 源文件（{units}）中不包含{count}张此类卡牌。如果模组添加了这些卡牌，请在“文件”选项卡中添加{file}，以便 军械库对其应用模组的规则。

Divisions.Battlegroup.Problem.VeterancyN.english: {unit}: the division does not offer veterancy {level}.

Divisions.Battlegroup.Problem.TooManyCar.english: {type}: {count} cards, the division has room for {allowed}.

Divisions.Pane.Battlegroup.Link.Tip.english: Opens it on the Battlegroups sub-tab
Divisions.Pane.Battlegroup.Link.Tip.text: 在“战斗群”子选项卡中打开该窗口

Divisions.Card.Cards.Tip.text: 该师中拥有 {count} 张该单位的卡牌

Divisions.Veterancy.Count.Tip.text: 服役等级 {level}：每张卡{units}个单位

Divisions.Veterancy.Popup.Note.english: Each number is a multiplier: a card at that level holds the units per card times it, rounded. 0: the level is not offered.
Divisions.Veterancy.Popup.Note.text: 每个数字都是一个倍数：该等级的卡牌所含单位数为“每张卡牌的单位数”乘以该倍数，并四舍五入。0：该等级不可用。

Divisions.Veterancy.Multiplier.Tip.english: A multiplier, from 0 to 1, of the units per card at this level; 0: not offered
Divisions.Veterancy.Multiplier.Tip.text: 该等级下每张卡牌所含单位数量的倍数，范围为 0 到 1；0：未提供

Divisions.Veterancy.EmptyPack.Why.english: The game won't generate the mod with an empty card (WARNO v210942 on). Raise the number, or use 0 to leave the level out.
Divisions.Veterancy.EmptyPack.Why.text: 如果卡片为空，游戏将不会生成模组（WARNO v210942 及以上版本）。请增加该数值，或使用 0 跳过该关卡。

Divisions.Veterancy.EmptyPack.Tip.english: Veterancy level {level}: {units} units per card × {share} rounds to no unit, and the game won't generate a mod with an empty card. Raise it, or use 0 to leave the level out.
Divisions.Veterancy.EmptyPack.Tip.text: 服役等级 {level}：每张卡牌 {units} 个单位 × {share} 轮后单位归零，且游戏不会生成卡牌为空的模组。提高该数值，或使用 0 跳过该等级。

Divisions.Veterancy.CountByPhase.Tip.english: Veterancy level {level}: {units} units per card in phases A / B / C
Divisions.Veterancy.CountByPhase.Tip.text: 服役等级 {level}：A/B/C阶段中每张卡牌拥有 {units} 个单位

Divisions.Phase.All.Tip.english: Each card shows its units in every phase: A / B / C
Divisions.Phase.All.Tip.text: 每张卡牌显示了其在各个阶段的单位：A / B / C

Divisions.Phase.One.Tip.english: Each card shows its units in phase {phase}; cards that can't be taken in it are dimmed
Divisions.Phase.One.Tip.text: 每张卡牌都会显示其处于{phase}阶段的单位；该阶段无法选中的卡牌会呈灰色显示

Divisions.Veterancy.Edit.Tip.english: Click to change the multiplier of each level
Divisions.Veterancy.Edit.Tip.text: 点击可更改各等级的倍数

Divisions.UnitPopup.InDivision.text: 在{division}中 · 仅此师中该单位的数值。

Divisions.Transports.Group.Tip.text: 点击可勾选所显示的所有{kind}，或在全部勾选时取消勾选所有选项

Divisions.Transports.Popup.Search.Tip.text: 仅显示名称中包含此内容的运输工具

Divisions.Transports.Popup.TickAll.Tip.text: 勾选所有显示的运输工具

Divisions.Transports.Popup.UntickAll.Tip.text: 取消勾选所有显示的运输方式

Divisions.Transports.Popup.NoneFound.text: 没有该名称的运输工具。

Divisions.Transports.Popup.NoneAccepted.text: 游戏不接受该单位的运输方式。

Divisions.Transports.Button.None.Tip.english: No transports. Click to choose some
Divisions.Transports.Button.None.Tip.text: 没有运输工具。点击以选择一些

Divisions.Check.Ask.english: Some of the divisions and units this mod changes may not work in the game as they are:
Divisions.Check.Ask.text: 此模组修改的部分军团和单位，在游戏中的原始状态下可能无法正常运作：

Divisions.Check.AskSeveral.english: Some of the divisions and units these mods change may not work in the game as they are:
Divisions.Check.AskSeveral.text: 这些模组修改的部分军区和单位，在游戏中的原始状态下可能无法正常运作：

Divisions.Check.HideForSession.english: Don't show again during this session

Divisions.Check.DlcUnitLeftOut.english: {division} comes with a DLC, and the game stops on a card a mod adds to it: {unit} is left out of the export. Take it out of the division, or put it in a new division.
Divisions.Check.DlcUnitLeftOut.text: {division}附带一个DLC，而游戏会在模组添加的一张卡牌处卡住：{unit}未被包含在导出文件中。请将其从该军团中移出，或放入一个新的军团中。

Divisions.StartMissing.english: The mod's changes to {division} start from {start}, which the Armory's source doesn't have, so its division rules can't be made again. Choose the source the mod was made with, or a game version that has it.
Divisions.StartMissing.text: 该模组对{division}的修改始于{start}，而军械库的源文件中并不包含该内容，因此无法重新生成其师级规则。请选择制作该模组所用的源文件，或选择包含该内容的游戏版本。

Divisions.Check.NoCommandUnit.english: {division} has no command unit, which every deck needs.
Divisions.Check.NoCommandUnit.text: {division}没有指挥单位，而每个卡组都需要指挥单位。

Divisions.Check.Battlegroup.english: {division}'s Official Battlegroup: {problem} GenerateMod will stop on it.
Divisions.Check.Battlegroup.text: {division} 的官方战斗群：{problem} GenerateMod 会在此停止。

Divisions.Pane.Summary.Tip.text: 游戏军械库在“游戏玩法”下显示的几行内容

Divisions.Pane.History.Tip.english: The longer text the game's armory shows about the division
Divisions.Pane.History.Tip.text: 游戏军械库中显示的关于该师的详细说明

Divisions.Check.NoCards.english: {division}: {type} has units but no cards to take them with.
Divisions.Check.NoCards.text: {division}：{type} 拥有单位，但没有卡牌可以将其带入战场。

Divisions.Check.NoWayToTake.english: {division}: {unit} has no transport and cannot be taken without one.
Divisions.Check.NoWayToTake.text: {division}：{unit}没有运输载具，若无运输载具则无法被选中。

Divisions.Check.TransportNotAccepted.english: {division}: {unit} has the {transport} as a transport, which the game does not accept for it.
Divisions.Check.TransportNotAccepted.text: {division}：{unit} 将 {transport} 设为运输载具，但游戏不接受此配置。

Divisions.Transports.GiveAll.english: Give Every Unit All Its Transports
Divisions.Transports.GiveAll.text: “将所有运输工具分配给每个单位”

Divisions.Transports.GiveAll.Tip.text: 该师中所有能够乘坐运输车的单位，都会获得游戏中允许其使用的所有运输车

Divisions.Transports.TakeAll.Tip.text: 该师的每个单位都会失去其运输工具，且在没有运输工具的情况下仍可被俘虏

Divisions.Transports.NoneNeeded.Tip.english: The unit can also be taken without a transport
Divisions.Transports.NoneNeeded.Tip.text: 该单位也可以不使用运输工具直接被带走

Divisions.Pane.Phase.Tip.text: 开始时间：阶段开始时，以自战斗开始后的秒数计。收入：其提供的点数。奖励：开始时一次性提供的点数。

Divisions.Pane.Economy.Tip.english: The list of income choices a player picks from for this division (the game's DivisionEconomy lists): each choice gives an income in each phase.
Divisions.Pane.Economy.Tip.text: 玩家为该军团选择的收入选项列表（即游戏中的 DivisionEconomy 列表）：每个选项在每个阶段都会提供相应的收入。

Divisions.Pane.Missing.english: {count} of its units is not in this source|{count} of its units are not in this source

Divisions.New.Ask.english: Name of the new division, a {nation} one. It starts with 50 activation points, the game's usual card slots, no emblem, and only {unit}.
Divisions.New.Ask.text: 新军团名称，属于{nation}。初始拥有50点激活点数，卡位数量与游戏中常规设置相同，无徽章，且仅包含{unit}。

Divisions.New.AskMany.english: Name of the new division, a {nation} one. It starts with 50 activation points, the game's usual card slots, no emblem, and only the {count} units selected.
Divisions.New.AskMany.text: 新军团名称，隶属于{nation}。初始拥有50点激活点数，卡位数量与游戏标准一致，无徽章，且仅包含所选的{count}个单位。

Divisions.Revert.Ask.english: Undo {mod}'s changes to {division}? It goes back to the game's name and units, in the game's list.
Divisions.Revert.Ask.text: “撤销{mod}对{division}所做的更改？”这将恢复游戏列表中该游戏的名称和单位。

Divisions.Duplicate.Ask.english: Name of the copy of {division}. It is a new division in the mod, with the same details and units.
Divisions.Duplicate.Ask.text: {division} 副本的名称。这是模组中的一个新师，拥有相同的详细信息和部队。

Divisions.DeleteGame.Ask.english: Take {division} out of the game's list in {mod}? Players can no longer pick it, and decks made with it no longer open. Restore Division puts it back.
Divisions.DeleteGame.Ask.text: 将{division}从{mod}中的游戏列表中移除？玩家将无法再选择该师，且使用该师构建的卡组将无法打开。“恢复师团”可将其放回原处。

Divisions.Removed.Tip.english: {division}: taken out of the game's list by the open mod
Divisions.Removed.Tip.text: {division}：已被已启用的模组从游戏列表中移除

Divisions.Pane.RemovedInMod.english: Taken out of the game's list in {mod}
Divisions.Pane.RemovedInMod.text: 在{mod}版本中从游戏列表中移除

Divisions.NewDivision.Tip.english: New division in the open mod, with the details of the one shown
Divisions.NewDivision.Tip.text: 开放模组中的新师，显示了该师的详细信息

Divisions.NewEmpty.Ask.english: Name of the new division, a {nation} one: its nation can be changed in the Division pane. It starts with 50 activation points, the game's usual card slots, no emblem and no units: add them from a unit's menu.
Divisions.NewEmpty.Ask.text: 新军团的名称，属于{nation}：可在“军团”面板中更改其所属国家。初始拥有50点激活点数，游戏常规的卡牌槽位，无徽章且无单位：请从单位菜单中添加。

Divisions.NewEmpty.Ask.FromGameDivision.english: Name of the new division, a {nation} one: its nation can be changed in the Division pane. It starts with the activation points, card slots, phases and income choices of a game division of its nation, no emblem and no units: add them from a unit's menu.
Divisions.NewEmpty.Ask.FromGameDivision.text: 新军团的名称，属于{nation}：可在“军团”面板中更改其所属国家。它初始化时采用该国家游戏军团的激活点、卡牌槽、阶段和收入选项，没有徽章也没有单位：请从单位菜单中添加它们。

Divisions.SavedIn.text: 位于 {source} · 更改已保存至 {mod}

Divisions.SavedIn.Tip.english: Changes are saved in {mod}, the mod open on the Mods tab, and written with its export
Divisions.SavedIn.Tip.text: 更改保存在{mod}中（即“模组”选项卡中打开的模组），并通过其导出功能写入

Divisions.SavedIn.OtherGame.english: in {source} · not saved: {mod} is a {modGame} mod
Divisions.SavedIn.OtherGame.text: 在{source}中 · 未保存：{mod}是{modGame}的模组

Divisions.NoDivisionsYet.Off.english: Choose a source with divisions first
Divisions.NoDivisionsYet.Off.text: 请先选择包含军团的来源

Divisions.Veterancy.Tip.english: Veterancy level {level}: {units} units per card. The share of the units per card at this level; 0 where it is not offered
Divisions.Veterancy.Tip.text: 资历等级 {level}：每张卡牌 {units} 个单位。该等级下每张卡牌所含单位的比例；若未提供，则为 0

Divisions.Veterancy.Share.Tip.english: Veterancy level {level}: the share of the units per card at this level; 0 where it is not offered
Divisions.Veterancy.Share.Tip.text: 服役等级 {level}：该等级下每张卡牌所占单位的比例；若未提供，则显示为 0

Divisions.Pane.Tags.Tip.text: 该军团在游戏文件中的标签，按顺序以逗号分隔。游戏会根据这些标签对军团进行排序（“默认”选项将其放入列表）；其所属国家、阵营和类型会自动提供这些标签，除非在此处另行设置

Divisions.Pane.Emblem.Game.Tip.english: Use one of the game's emblems
Divisions.Pane.Emblem.Game.Tip.text: 使用游戏中的徽章之一

Divisions.Pane.Emblem.Picture.Tip.english: Use a picture of your own; it is kept as a .png the game's tools read, and the mod's export copies it into the mod
Divisions.Pane.Emblem.Picture.Tip.text: 请使用您自己的图片；该图片将以 .png 格式保存，游戏工具可读取此格式，且模组导出时会将其复制到模组中

Divisions.Pane.AddSlot.Tip.english: One more card of this category, costing as the last one
Divisions.Pane.AddSlot.Tip.text: 该类别中还有一张卡牌，费用与上一张相同

Divisions.Pane.AddStandout.Tip.english: Units of the division to show on its card in the game
Divisions.Pane.AddStandout.Tip.text: 该军团的单位将在游戏中的卡牌上显示

Rules.RuleWindow.ScanAFileWithout.Tip.english: Scan a file without adding it to the Files tab
Rules.RuleWindow.ScanAFileWithout.Tip.text: 扫描文件而不将其添加到“文件”选项卡中

Rules.ColumnSplit.Tip.english: Drag to resize. Double-click to reset.
Rules.ColumnSplit.Tip.text: 拖动以调整大小。双击以重置。

Rules.Watermark.OnSwitch.Tip.english: Add the watermark comment to files exported with this mod's rule sets
Rules.Watermark.OnSwitch.Tip.text: 将水印注释添加到使用此模组规则集导出的文件中

Rules.Watermark.AskTick.Tip.english: Before each Export, offer to update the watermark
Rules.Watermark.AskTick.Tip.text: 每次导出前，提示是否更新水印

Rules.Watermark.NeverTick.Tip.english: Stop asking before each export. "Ask on export" in the Watermark window turns it back on
Rules.Watermark.NeverTick.Tip.text: 停止在每次导出前提示。“水印”窗口中的“导出时询问”选项可重新启用该提示

Rules.Watermark.SavedWithThisMod.english: Saved with this mod and in its mod file.
Rules.Watermark.SavedWithThisMod.text: 已与该模组及其模组文件一同保存。

Rules.Watermark.Export.Tip.english: Export with these values, saved to the mod
Rules.Watermark.Export.Tip.text: 使用这些值导出，并保存到模组中

Rules.ModSwitch.Tip.english: On: the mod runs on export and Preview, after the mods above it. Off: it does not run.
Rules.ModSwitch.Tip.text: 开启：该模组在导出和预览时运行，且在它上方的模组之后执行。关闭：它不运行。

Rules.ModConflicts.Tip.english: {count} value another mod that is on also changes (the lower mod wins):|{count} values another mod that is on also changes (the lower mod wins):
Rules.ModConflicts.Tip.text: {count} 个值：另一个正在运行的模组也会发生变化（较低的模组值优先）：

Rules.ModConflicts.Click.english: Click to see them side by side in the Mod Conflicts window.
Rules.ModConflicts.Click.text: 点击可在“模组冲突”窗口中并排查看它们。

Rules.Menu.Game.Tip.english: The mod is for {game} from now on: it runs only on {game} files, and the Armory saves into it only changes made with a {game} source.
Rules.Menu.Game.Tip.text: 该模组从现在起仅适用于{game}：它仅在{game}文件上运行，而“军械库”也仅将使用{game}源文件所做的更改保存到该模组中。

Rules.ModGame.Tip.english: A mod for {game}: it runs only on {game} files. Right-click, Game, to change it.
Rules.ModGame.Tip.text: {game} 的模组：仅在 {game} 文件上运行。右键单击“游戏”以进行更改。

Rules.ModIdle.Tip.english: On, but none of the files on the Files tab is for {game}, so it runs on nothing.
Rules.ModIdle.Tip.text: 已开启，但“文件”选项卡中的文件均不属于{game}，因此无法运行。

Rules.ModLetter.Has.Tip.english: {part}: {count} rule from the Armory in this mod. Click to see it.|{part}: {count} rules from the Armory in this mod. Click to see them.
Rules.ModLetter.Has.Tip.text: {part}：此模组中“军械库”中的 {count} 条规则。点击查看。

Rules.ModLetter.None.Tip.english: {part}: no changes from the Armory in this mod. Click to open {part}.
Rules.ModLetter.None.Tip.text: {part}：此模组中该部分与“军械库”中的内容无异。点击可打开 {part}。

Rules.FoldGroup.Tip.english: Hide what is in this group

Rules.UnfoldGroup.Tip.english: Show what is in this group

Rules.Menu.DeleteGroup.Tip.english: What is in the group is kept.

Rules.Group.Exists.english: A group with that name already exists.

Rules.ModGroupSwitch.Tip.english: On: its mods that are on run. Off: none of them run; each keeps its own switch.
Rules.ModGroupSwitch.Tip.text: 开启：其模组正在运行。关闭：均未运行；每个模组都有独立的开关。

Rules.PresetGroup.Hidden.english: {count} rule set hidden|{count} rule sets hidden

Rules.DeletePreset.Tip.text: 删除选中的规则集（删除）

Rules.NoPresetsInThis.english: No rule sets in this mod.

Rules.NewRule.Tip.english: Add a rule below the selected one. Ctrl+N adds an Edit rule
Rules.NewRule.Tip.text: 在所选规则下方添加一条规则。按Ctrl+N可添加“编辑规则”

Rules.Fold.Tip.english: Hide the rules in this group

Rules.Editor.Choice.End.AtTheEnd.english: At the end of the file

Rules.Editor.AfterHint.DescriptorToAdd.text: 要添加到其后面的描述符

Rules.Editor.NewIds.english: Give the copy its own GUIDs
Rules.Editor.NewIds.text: 为副本分配独立的 GUID

Rules.Editor.MinHint.MinimumEmptyFor.text: 最小值；若为空则表示无。

Rules.Editor.MaxHint.MaximumEmptyFor.text: 最大值；若为空则表示无。

Rules.Editor.CollectHint.DescriptorTitle.english: Descriptor Title, or a property name
Rules.Editor.CollectHint.DescriptorTitle.text: 描述符标题，或属性名称

Rules.Editor.WhereThisMatchesA.english: Where this matches a collected value
Rules.Editor.WhereThisMatchesA.text: 当此处与收集到的值匹配时

Rules.Editor.ExtraConditionsInThis.text: 此文件中的额外条件（可选）

Rules.Editor.MessageHint.OptionalNoteTo.text: 供自己参考的可选备注

Rules.Editor.Group.Note.english: Holds the rules below it, up to the next group. They only touch descriptors that also meet these conditions, and disabling the group disables them. With no conditions it is just a heading.
Rules.Editor.Group.Note.text: 包含其下方的规则，直至下一个组。这些规则仅作用于同时满足这些条件的描述符，禁用该组即会禁用这些规则。若无条件，则仅作为标题。

Rules.Editor.Add.Note.english: Runs once per file. Skipped if the name is already in the file or the text is not valid NDF. Written as typed; later rules do not edit it.
Rules.Editor.Add.Note.text: 每个文件运行一次。如果名称已在文件中存在或文本不是有效的NDF格式，则跳过。按输入内容写入；后续规则不会对其进行编辑。

Rules.Editor.Clone.Note.english: Copies the descriptor as it is when this rule runs and places the copy after it. Later rules can edit the copy. Skipped if the new name exists. New GUIDs come from the new name, so they are the same on every export.
Rules.Editor.Clone.Note.text: 在运行此规则时，将描述符按原样复制，并将副本放置在其后。后续规则可以编辑该副本。如果新名称已存在，则跳过此操作。新的 GUID 来自新名称，因此在每次导出时都保持一致。

Rules.Editor.Remove.Note.english: **Deletes every descriptor that meets the conditions.** Needs at least one condition.
Rules.Editor.Remove.Note.text: **删除所有满足条件的描述符。**至少需要一个条件。

Rules.Editor.Replace.Note.english: Checks every value in the descriptor. Property names and the descriptor's name are not changed.
Rules.Editor.Replace.Note.text: 检查描述符中的每个值。属性名称和描述符名称不会被更改。

Rules.Editor.Formula.Note.english: Takes property names from the same descriptor, numbers, + - * / and brackets. `value` is the target's current value. A name with a slash goes in square brackets: `[EVisionRange/Standard]`. Functions: min, max, abs, floor, ceil, round(x), round(x, step). A descriptor is skipped if a property is missing or not a number.
Rules.Editor.Formula.Note.text: 支持从同一描述符中提取属性名称、数字、+ - * / 以及括号。`value`是目标的当前值。 包含斜杠的名称需用方括号括起：`[EVisionRange/Standard]`。函数：min、max、abs、floor、ceil、round(x)、round(x, step)。若属性缺失或非数值，则跳过该描述符。

Rules.Editor.Table.Note.english: Paste from a spreadsheet, or type text separated by commas, semicolons or tabs. First row: property names. First column: descriptor names. Empty cells are skipped. Rows for descriptors not in the file are listed under Skipped.
Rules.Editor.Table.Note.text: 从电子表格中粘贴，或输入以逗号、分号或制表符分隔的文本。第一行：属性名称。第一列：描述符名称。空单元格将被跳过。文件中不存在的描述符所在的行将列在“已跳过”下。

Rules.Editor.Lookup.Note.english: Edits descriptors in this file from a list read in another file. The other file must be on the Files tab; it is read as loaded, before its own rules.
Rules.Editor.Lookup.Note.text: 根据从另一个文件读取的列表编辑本文件中的描述符。该文件必须位于“文件”选项卡下；它将在加载时被读取，且优先于本文件的规则。

Rules.Editor.Lookup.ReferenceNote.english: A reference matches by its last part: `$/GFX/Weapon/WeaponDescriptor_X` matches `WeaponDescriptor_X`.
Rules.Editor.Lookup.ReferenceNote.text: 引用通过其最后一部分进行匹配：`$/GFX/Weapon/WeaponDescriptor_X` 匹配 `WeaponDescriptor_X`。

Rules.Editor.Check.Note.english: Changes nothing. Counts the descriptors that meet the conditions and warns on the Files tab when the count is not as expected, such as after a game update renamed something.
Rules.Editor.Check.Note.text: 不进行任何更改。仅统计满足条件的描述符，并在“文件”选项卡中发出警告，例如当游戏更新后某些文件被重命名，导致计数与预期不符时。

Rules.Editor.Scope.RemoveTypeNote.english: Takes every object of this type that passes the conditions out of the list it is in. Objects not in a list are left alone.
Rules.Editor.Scope.RemoveTypeNote.text: 将满足条件的所有该类型的对象从其所在的列表中移出。未在列表中的对象保持不变。

Rules.Editor.Scope.TypeNote.english: Runs on every object of this type, at any depth. Conditions and targets see only that object. Descriptor Title is the title of its descriptor; Descriptor Type is its own type.
Rules.Editor.Scope.TypeNote.text: 对该类型的每个对象运行，无论嵌套深度如何。条件和目标仅视该对象。描述符标题是其描述符的标题；描述符类型是其自身类型。

Rules.Editor.Scope.ConstantsNote.english: Runs on top-level values written as `Name is 5`. Together they act as one descriptor: use a constant's name as a target or in a condition.
Rules.Editor.Scope.ConstantsNote.text: 作用于以`Name is 5`形式书写的顶级值。它们共同作为单个描述符：可将常量的名称用作目标或用于条件中。

Rules.Editor.Variable.Note.english: Write `{variable}` in any value, condition, table cell or formula. Formulas also take the bare name. Applies to the whole rule set, wherever it sits, unless its group is switched off.
Rules.Editor.Variable.Note.text: 在任何值、条件、表格单元格或公式中输入`{variable}`。公式也可直接使用名称。该规则适用于整个规则集（无论位于何处），除非其所属组已被禁用。

Rules.Editor.Add.Text.Tip.english: Paste the whole descriptor, from its comment or export line. Ctrl+scroll changes the text size.
Rules.Editor.Add.Text.Tip.text: 粘贴整个描述符，包括其注释或导出行。按Ctrl+scroll可调整文本大小。

Rules.Editor.Lookup.SourceConditions.english: Descriptors to read in the other file
Rules.Editor.Lookup.SourceConditions.text: 需从其他文件中读取的描述符

Rules.Editor.Lookup.ToEdit.english: Descriptors to edit in this file
Rules.Editor.Lookup.ToEdit.text: 本文件中需编辑的描述符

Rules.Editor.Enabled.Tip.english: Off: the rule stays in the list and does not run
Rules.Editor.Enabled.Tip.text: 关闭：规则保留在列表中，但不会运行

Rules.Editor.Gate.Tip.english: Any: one condition is enough. All: every condition must match.
Rules.Editor.Gate.Tip.text: 任意：满足一个条件即可。全部：所有条件都必须匹配。

Rules.Editor.Fill.Tip.text: 从已扫描的文件中选择

Rules.Mod.Exists.english: A mod with that name already exists.

Rules.Mod.Game.Tip.english: The game the mod is for: it runs only on that game's files, and the Armory saves into it only changes made with a source of that game.
Rules.Mod.Game.Tip.text: 该模组对应的游戏：它仅在该游戏的文件上运行，且“军械库”仅将使用该游戏源文件所做的更改保存到该游戏中。

Rules.Mod.DeleteAskWithPresets.english: Delete the mod "{mod}" and its {presets}? Export it first if you want to keep a copy.
Rules.Mod.DeleteAskWithPresets.text: 删除模组“{mod}”及其{presets}？若要保留副本，请先将其导出。

Rules.Mod.ImportExists.english: A mod named "{mod}" already exists, with {existing}. The file holds {count}. Replace it, keep both, or skip?
Rules.Mod.ImportExists.text: 已存在名为“{mod}”的模组，其名称为 {existing}。该文件包含 {count} 项。要替换它、保留两个，还是跳过？

Rules.Mod.NotSaved.english: The mod could not be saved. {reason}

Rules.ClipboardBusy.english: The clipboard is in use by another program. Try again.
Rules.ClipboardBusy.text: 剪贴板正被其他程序使用。请重试。

Rules.Preset.NewName.english: Name for the new rule set:

Rules.Preset.SelectToCopy.english: Select a rule set to copy.
Rules.Preset.SelectToCopy.text: 请选择要复制的规则集。

Rules.Rule.SelectToCopy.text: 选择一条规则进行复制。

Rules.Preset.Exists.english: This mod already has a rule set with that name.
Rules.Preset.Exists.text: 此模组已有同名的规则集。

Rules.Preset.FilesUseIt.english: It applies to {count} file on the Files tab.|It applies to {count} files on the Files tab.
Rules.Preset.FilesUseIt.text: 它适用于“文件”选项卡中的 {count} 个文件。

Rules.Preset.FilesUseThem.english: They apply to {count} file on the Files tab.|They apply to {count} files on the Files tab.
Rules.Preset.FilesUseThem.text: 它们适用于“文件”选项卡中的 {count} 个文件。

Rules.NoRules.english: No rules yet. Click "New Rule" to add one, or paste rules with Ctrl+V.
Rules.NoRules.text: 尚无规则。点击“新建规则”以添加一条，或使用 Ctrl+V 粘贴规则。

Rules.NoRulesNoPreset.english: No rules yet. Click "New Rule" to add one; it also creates a rule set to hold it.
Rules.NoRulesNoPreset.text: 尚无规则。点击“新建规则”以添加一条；这也会创建一个规则集来存放该规则。

Rules.Paste.Nothing.english: The clipboard holds no EasyNDF rule set, rule, condition or action.
Rules.Paste.Nothing.text: 剪贴板中没有EasyNDF规则集、规则、条件或操作。

Rules.Paste.SelectRule.english: Select a rule before pasting conditions or actions.
Rules.Paste.SelectRule.text: 在粘贴条件或操作之前，请先选择一条规则。

Rules.Paste.MadePreset.english: Created the rule set "{preset}" for it. Rename it after its file, such as "My mod (Ammunition.ndf)", or set its Applies To, and it runs on that file.
Rules.Paste.MadePreset.text: 为此创建了规则集“{preset}”。将其重命名为与文件同名，例如“My mod (Ammunition.ndf)”，或设置其“适用对象”，该规则将应用于该文件。

Rules.Paste.PresetsDone.text: 已将剪贴板中的 {presets} 粘贴到“{mod}”中。

Rules.Rows.SelectFirst.english: Select one or more rows first.

Rules.Paste.NoConditionsHere.english: The selected rule is a type that does not take conditions.
Rules.Paste.NoConditionsHere.text: 所选规则属于不接受条件的类型。

Rules.Paste.NoActionsHere.english: The selected rule is a type that does not take actions.
Rules.Paste.NoActionsHere.text: 所选规则属于不支持操作的类型。

Rules.KindSummary.Edit.english: Changes values in every descriptor that matches. The one you'll use most.
Rules.KindSummary.Edit.text: 修改所有匹配描述符中的值。这是你使用最频繁的功能。

Rules.KindSummary.Add.english: Adds a new descriptor, written exactly as you type it.
Rules.KindSummary.Add.text: 添加一个新的描述符，其写法与您输入的内容完全一致。

Rules.KindSummary.Clone.english: Copies a descriptor under a new name, then changes the copy.
Rules.KindSummary.Clone.text: 将描述符复制为新名称，然后修改该副本。

Rules.KindSummary.Remove.english: Deletes every descriptor that matches. Needs at least one condition.
Rules.KindSummary.Remove.text: 删除所有匹配的描述符。至少需要一个条件。

Rules.KindSummary.Replace.english: Replaces a value wherever it appears.
Rules.KindSummary.Replace.text: 替换该值的所有出现位置。

Rules.KindSummary.Scale.english: Changes a number, then rounds it and keeps it within limits you set.
Rules.KindSummary.Scale.text: 修改一个数值，然后对其进行四舍五入，并确保其保持在您设定的限制范围内。

Rules.KindSummary.Formula.english: Works out a value from other values, like `round(0.8 * MaximumRangeGRU, 25)`.
Rules.KindSummary.Formula.text: 根据其他值计算出一个值，例如`round(0.8 * MaximumRangeGRU, 25)`。

Rules.KindSummary.Table.english: Applies values pasted from a spreadsheet: one row per descriptor.
Rules.KindSummary.Table.text: 应用从电子表格中粘贴的值：每个描述符占一行。

Rules.KindSummary.Lookup.english: Changes descriptors based on a list in another file.
Rules.KindSummary.Lookup.text: 根据另一个文件中的列表修改描述符。

Rules.KindSummary.Check.english: Changes nothing. Warns you when the number of matches isn't what you expect.
Rules.KindSummary.Check.text: 不做任何更改。当匹配数量与预期不符时会发出警告。

Rules.KindSummary.Group.english: A heading with one on/off switch for the rules under it.
Rules.KindSummary.Group.text: 一个标题，其下方的规则可通过一个开关进行启用或禁用。

Rules.KindSummary.Variable.english: A named value you can use in other rules as `{Name}`. Change it once to change many rules.
Rules.KindSummary.Variable.text: 一个可在其他规则中以 `{Name}` 形式使用的命名值。只需修改一次即可更新多条规则。

Rules.Group.DeleteAsk.english: Deleting a group heading leaves its rules in the group above, or in none. Delete it?
Rules.Group.DeleteAsk.text: 删除组标题会将其规则保留在上一级组中，或归为“无”。要删除吗？

Rules.Group.DoNotAskAgain.english: Do not ask again until the app is closed
Rules.Group.DoNotAskAgain.text: 直到关闭应用前不再提示

Rules.Rule.SelectToCut.text: 选择一条规则进行剪切。

Rules.Scan.Hint.english: Scan a file to fill the dropdowns. Files on the Files tab are scanned automatically.
Rules.Scan.Hint.text: 扫描文件以填充下拉列表。 “文件”选项卡中的文件会自动被扫描。

Rules.Watermark.Lead.english: Exporting with the watermark of {mod}. Change anything that is out of date:
Rules.Watermark.Lead.text: 正在使用{mod}的水印进行导出。请修改任何过时的信息：

Rules.Row.Custom.Tip.english: Type a name instead of choosing one
Rules.Row.Custom.Tip.text: 请直接输入名称，而非选择名称

Rules.Row.Value.Tip.english: Enter closes this window. Shift+Enter adds a line break.
Rules.Row.Value.Tip.text: 按 Enter 键可关闭此窗口。按 Shift+Enter 键可插入换行符。

Rules.Row.ActionNote.english: A target is a property name at any depth, or the key of a MAP pair. Insert and Replace take `index:value`; index is a number, FirstIndex, LastIndex, or an offset like LastIndex-1. \n is a line break. {Name} inserts a variable.
Rules.Row.ActionNote.text: 目标是任意深度的属性名称，或 MAP 对的键。插入和替换操作接受 `index:value`；索引可以是数字、FirstIndex、LastIndex，或是类似 LastIndex-1 的偏移量。\n 表示换行。{Name} 用于插入变量。

Rules.Row.Comment.Tip.english: Add a comment after each edited value
Rules.Row.Comment.Tip.text: 在每个已编辑的值后添加注释

Rules.Row.OriginalValue.Tip.english: Add the value before the edit

Rules.Suggest.Round.Tip.english: round(x): Round to the nearest whole number.\nround(x, step): Round to the nearest step, like 25.
Rules.Suggest.Round.Tip.text: round(x)：四舍五入到最接近的整数。\nround(x, step)：四舍五入到最接近的步长，例如 25。

Rules.Suggest.Value.Tip.english: The current value of the property being changed.
Rules.Suggest.Value.Tip.text: 正在修改的属性的当前值。

Rules.Suggest.Abs.Tip.english: The value without its minus sign.

Rules.Suggest.Floor.Tip.english: Round down to a whole number.

Rules.Suggest.Ceil.Tip.english: Round up to a whole number.

Rules.Suggest.FirstIndex.Tip.english: The list's first item, the same as 0.
Rules.Suggest.FirstIndex.Tip.text: 列表的第一个项目，等同于 0。

Rules.Suggest.LastIndex.Tip.english: The list's last item. LastIndex-1 is the one before it.
Rules.Suggest.LastIndex.Tip.text: 列表的最后一项。LastIndex-1 表示其前一项。

Rules.Suggest.Variable.Tip.english: A variable of this rule set, set by its Variable rule.
Rules.Suggest.Variable.Tip.text: 该规则集中的一个变量，由其“Variable”规则设置。

Rules.Suggest.Descriptor.Tip.english: A descriptor in the scanned file.

Rules.Suggest.Type.Tip.english: A descriptor type in the scanned file.
Rules.Suggest.Type.Tip.text: 扫描文件中的描述符类型。

Rules.Suggest.Property.Tip.english: A property in the scanned file.
Rules.Suggest.Property.Tip.text: 扫描文件中的一个属性。

Rules.Locked.Tip.english: Made from the Armory: change it there, or open it and choose Make Editable.
Rules.Locked.Tip.text: 来自“军械库”：请在该处进行修改，或打开文件并选择“设为可编辑”。

Rules.Locked.Refused.english: Rules made from the Armory are changed there. To change one here, open it and choose Make Editable.
Rules.Locked.Refused.text: 从军械库创建的规则需在军械库中进行修改。若要在此处修改，请打开该规则并选择“设为可编辑”。

Rules.Locked.DeleteAsk.english: These rules are changes made in the Armory. Deleting them takes the changes back there: a game division gets those values back as the game has them, and a division or unit the mod makes is deleted whole (a unit is taken out of the mod's divisions too); a battlegroup's rules empty only its battlegroup. Delete them?
Rules.Locked.DeleteAsk.text: 这些规则是“军械库”中进行的修改。 删除它们会将更改撤回至军械库：游戏师将恢复为游戏原有的数值，而模组创建的师或单位将被整体删除（该单位也会从模组的师中移除）；战斗群的规则仅会清空其所属的战斗群。要删除吗？

Rules.Locked.PresetDeleteAsk.english: It holds changes made in the Armory: they are all taken back, and the mod's own divisions and units are deleted.
Rules.Locked.PresetDeleteAsk.text: 它保存了在军械库中进行的更改：这些更改均被撤销，且该模组自带的师和部队被删除。

Rules.Locked.BattlegroupsDeleteAsk.english: It holds the battlegroups changed in the Armory: they are all taken back, and the mod's own divisions get empty battlegroups again.
Rules.Locked.BattlegroupsDeleteAsk.text: 它保存了在军械库中修改的战斗群：这些修改均被撤销，模组自带的师级单位再次恢复为空战斗群。

Rules.Locked.PresetRefused.english: An Armory rule set holds changes made in the Armory. Undo them in the Armory to remove it.
Rules.Locked.PresetRefused.text: “军械库”规则集保存了在“军械库”中进行的更改。在“军械库”中撤销这些更改即可将其移除。

Rules.Locked.Text.english: It follows what you change there, so it is read-only here.
Rules.Locked.Text.text: 它会跟随您在那里的更改，因此此处为只读状态。

Rules.Locked.ShowInArmory.Tip.english: Show this rule's division or unit in the Armory.
Rules.Locked.ShowInArmory.Tip.text: 在军械库中显示此规则所属的师或单位。

Rules.Locked.MakeEditable.Tip.english: Keep this rule by hand from now on. The Armory stops showing the change.
Rules.Locked.MakeEditable.Tip.text: 从现在起请手动保留此规则。“军械库”将不再显示该更改。

Rules.Locked.MakeEditable.Ask.english: Keep this change as a rule you edit by hand? The Armory lets go of it: it no longer shows or changes it. For a new division or unit, all of its rules are kept by hand; for a new division's battlegroup, only its battlegroup's rules.
Rules.Locked.MakeEditable.Ask.text: “将此更改保留为手动编辑的规则吗？”军械库将不再关注此项：它将不再显示或更改该内容。对于新组建的师或部队，其所有规则均需手动维护；对于新组建的师所属的战斗群，则仅需维护该战斗群的规则。

Rules.Locked.ArmoryNotRead.english: Open the Armory first, so its divisions and units are read.
Rules.Locked.ArmoryNotRead.text: 请先打开军械库，以便读取其中的师和部队。

Rules.Armory.OwnRulesElsewhere.english: Armory rule sets only hold changes made in the Armory.
Rules.Armory.OwnRulesElsewhere.text: “军械库”规则集仅包含在“军械库”中进行的更改。

Rules.Armory.NoChanges.english: No changes yet. Changes made in the Armory's {part} sub-tab show here as rules.
Rules.Armory.NoChanges.text: 尚未进行任何更改。在“军械库”的{part}子选项卡中进行的更改将在此处显示为规则。

Rules.Armory.Divisions.Tip.english: The changes made to divisions in the Armory, as rules. They run on the division files on the Files tab when you export.
Rules.Armory.Divisions.Tip.text: 在“军械库”中对师级单位所做的修改，以规则形式呈现。导出时，这些规则将在“文件”选项卡中的师级单位文件上运行。

Rules.Armory.Battlegroups.Tip.english: The changes made to Official Battlegroups in the Armory, as rules. They run on Decks.ndf and DeckPacks.ndf on the Files tab when you export.
Rules.Armory.Battlegroups.Tip.text: 在“军械库”中对“官方战斗群”所做的修改，以规则形式呈现。导出时，这些规则将在“文件”选项卡中的 Decks.ndf 和 DeckPacks.ndf 文件上运行。

Rules.Armory.Units.Tip.english: The units made in the Armory, as rules. They run on UniteDescriptor.ndf, DeckSerializer.ndf and, for a card picture of your own, ButtonTexturesUnites.ndf on the Files tab when you export.
Rules.Armory.Units.Tip.text: 在“军械库”中创建的单位，以规则形式存在。导出时，它们将在“文件”选项卡中通过 UniteDescriptor.ndf、DeckSerializer.ndf 以及（若使用自定义卡牌图片）ButtonTexturesUnites.ndf 运行。

Rules.AppliesTo.None.Tip.english: This rule set runs on no file: its name holds no file name, and it lists none. Click Change… to choose its files.
Rules.AppliesTo.None.Tip.text: 此规则集未应用于任何文件：其名称中不包含任何文件名，且未列出任何文件。单击“更改…”以选择要应用该规则集的文件。

Rules.AppliesTo.Change.Tip.english: Choose the files this rule set applies to
Rules.AppliesTo.Change.Tip.text: 选择此规则集适用的文件

Rules.AppliesTo.Close.Tip.text: 不作任何更改直接关闭（Esc）

Rules.AppliesTo.ByName.Tip.english: On: the rule set applies to the files its name holds. Off: to the files ticked below.
Rules.AppliesTo.ByName.Tip.text: 开启：该规则集适用于其名称中包含的文件。关闭：适用于下方勾选的文件。

Rules.AppliesTo.NameHolds.english: Its name holds {files}, so it applies to the files of that name. Renaming the rule set changes them.
Rules.AppliesTo.NameHolds.text: 其名称包含{files}，因此该规则适用于名称为这些的文件。重命名规则集将更改这些规则。

Rules.AppliesTo.NameHoldsNone.english: Its name holds no file name, so by its name it applies to no file.
Rules.AppliesTo.NameHoldsNone.text: 其名称中不包含任何文件名，因此根据其名称，该规则不适用于任何文件。

Rules.AppliesTo.Add.Tip.english: Add the file typed in, ticked
Rules.AppliesTo.Add.Tip.text: 添加已输入并勾选的文件

Rules.AppliesTo.TypedFile.Hint.english: A file not on the Files tab, such as Strategic/GDConstants.ndf
Rules.AppliesTo.TypedFile.Hint.text: “文件”选项卡中未列出的文件，例如 Strategic/GDConstants.ndf

Rules.AppliesTo.TypedFile.Tip.english: A file name, with the folders it sits in before it to pick one of two files of the same name
Rules.AppliesTo.TypedFile.Tip.text: 一个文件名，前面带有其所在的文件夹路径，用于从两个同名文件中选择其一

Rules.AppliesTo.Note.english: A folder before the name, as in Strategic/GDConstants.ndf, picks one of two files of the same name. Kept in the mod, so it goes with the mod when it is shared.
Rules.AppliesTo.Note.text: 名称前带有文件夹（例如 Strategic/GDConstants.ndf），用于在两个同名文件中选择其一。该文件保留在模组中，因此在共享模组时会随模组一同分享。

Rules.AppliesTo.Done.Tip.english: Keep this choice in the mod

Rules.AppliesTo.Cancel.Tip.text: 不作任何更改直接关闭

Rules.KindSummary.Text.english: Adds texts to a dictionary file such as UNITS.csv: one line per token.
Rules.KindSummary.Text.text: 将文本添加到字典文件（如 UNITS.csv）中：每行一个标记。

Rules.KindSummary.File.english: Puts a file of your own into the mod on export: a picture, a video, a new NDF file.
Rules.KindSummary.File.text: 在导出时将您自定义的文件放入模组中：图片、视频、新的NDF文件。

Rules.Editor.Text.Note.english: One text per line: `TOKEN;Text`. The rule set must apply to a dictionary file on the Files tab, such as `UNITS.csv` or `INTERFACE_OUTGAME.csv`; the export writes it with these lines added, in place of lines with the same token.
Rules.Editor.Text.Note.text: 每行一个文本：`TOKEN;Text`。该规则集必须适用于“文件”选项卡中的字典文件，例如 `UNITS.csv` 或 `INTERFACE_OUTGAME.csv`；导出时会将这些行添加到文件中，并替换掉包含相同标记的行。

Rules.Editor.File.Note.english: The file is written into the mod's folder on export: the folder that holds the GameData (or CommonData) folder of a file this rule set applies to. EasyNDF keeps its own copy, so the mod still has the file if the chosen one is moved or changed. Export Mod carries the file with the mod.
Rules.Editor.File.Note.text: 导出时，该文件将写入模组的文件夹中：即该规则集所适用的文件的GameData（或CommonData）文件夹所在的文件夹。EasyNDF会保留自己的副本，因此即使选定的文件被移动或更改，模组仍会保留该文件。“导出模组”功能会将该文件随模组一同携带。

Rules.Editor.File.Choose.Tip.english: Choose the file to put into the mod
Rules.Editor.File.Choose.Tip.text: 选择要放入模组的文件

Rules.Editor.File.Choose.Title.english: Choose the File to Put Into the Mod
Rules.Editor.File.Choose.Title.text: 选择要放入模组的文件

Rules.Editor.File.Missing.english: {file}: EasyNDF no longer has this file. Choose it again.
Rules.Editor.File.Missing.text: {file}：EasyNDF 中已无此文件。请重新选择。

Rules.Editor.File.DestinationHint.english: Where in the mod, such as GameData/Assets/2D/Logo.png
Rules.Editor.File.DestinationHint.text: 模组中的位置，例如 GameData/Assets/2D/Logo.png

Rules.RenameMod.Tip.text: 重命名当前打开的模组（F2）

Rules.ExportMod.Tip.english: Save the open mod as a mod file, to share or keep
Rules.ExportMod.Tip.text: 将打开的模组保存为模组文件，以便分享或保存

Rules.WatermarkButton.Tip.english: The comment naming the open mod at the top of the files it exports
Rules.WatermarkButton.Tip.text: 导出文件顶部标注当前打开的模组的注释

Rules.DeleteMod.Tip.english: Delete the open mod and its rule sets (Delete)
Rules.DeleteMod.Tip.text: 删除当前打开的模组及其规则集（删除）

Rules.Unfold.Tip.english: Show the rules in this group

Rules.RenamePreset.Off.Several.english: Select only one rule set to rename it
Rules.RenamePreset.Off.Several.text: 请仅选择一个规则集进行重命名

Rules.RenamePreset.Off.Armory.english: A rule set of Armory changes is named after its part of the Armory
Rules.RenamePreset.Off.Armory.text: 军械库更改的规则集以军械库中的相应部件命名

Rules.AppliesTo.ByNameIsOn.Off.english: Switch off "From its name" to choose the files yourself
Rules.AppliesTo.ByNameIsOn.Off.text: 关闭“根据文件名”选项，以便手动选择文件

Rules.AppliesTo.Search.Tip.english: Show only the files whose name holds this (Escape clears it)
Rules.AppliesTo.Search.Tip.text: 仅显示名称中包含此内容的文件（按 Esc 键清空）

Rules.AppliesTo.NoFiles.english: No files on the Files tab yet.

Rules.AppliesTo.NoMatch.english: No file has that in its name.
Rules.AppliesTo.NoMatch.text: 没有文件名称中包含该内容。

Rules.Watermark.VersionBox.Tip.english: The mod's version, shown in the watermark
Rules.Watermark.VersionBox.Tip.text: 模组版本，显示在水印中

Rules.Watermark.GameBox.Tip.english: The game version the mod is made for, shown in the watermark
Rules.Watermark.GameBox.Tip.text: 该模组所适配的游戏版本，显示在水印中

Rules.Watermark.Off.english: Switch on Enable to fill this in
Rules.Watermark.Off.text: 请开启“启用”选项以填写此内容

Settings.Colour.Spectrum.Tip.english: Hue across, saturation down. Drag to change the color
Settings.Colour.Spectrum.Tip.text: 色相横向调整，饱和度纵向调整。拖动以更改颜色

Settings.Colour.HexBox.Tip.text: 颜色以十六进制形式表示，例如#7fb88a

Settings.Colour.AddToCustomColors.Tip.english: Keep this color in the next custom color box
Settings.Colour.AddToCustomColors.Tip.text: 将此颜色保留在下一个自定义颜色框中

Settings.Fonts.ForEveryThemeThe.english: For every theme. The theme's font is the one the theme names, or the usual one.
Settings.Fonts.ForEveryThemeThe.text: 适用于每个主题。主题的字体即为该主题指定的字体，或默认字体。

Settings.Fonts.UiSearch.Tip.english: Show only fonts whose name holds this
Settings.Fonts.UiSearch.Tip.text: 仅显示名称中包含此内容的字体

Settings.Fonts.UiList.Tip.english: The font for the app's text: buttons, lists and labels
Settings.Fonts.UiList.Tip.text: 应用程序文本的字体：按钮、列表和标签

Settings.Fonts.FixedOnly.Tip.english: List only fonts whose letters are all the same width, which keep NDF text lined up
Settings.Fonts.FixedOnly.Tip.text: 仅列出所有字符宽度相同的字体，这些字体可确保NDF文本对齐

Settings.Fonts.CodeList.Tip.english: The font for file names, values and the Editor
Settings.Fonts.CodeList.Tip.text: 文件名、数值和编辑器的字体

Settings.Fonts.RulesRunTopTo.english: Rules run top to bottom. Double-click a rule to open it.
Settings.Fonts.RulesRunTopTo.text: 规则从上到下排列。双击一条规则可将其展开。

Settings.Fonts.UseTheThemesFonts.Tip.english: Go back to the fonts the theme names

Settings.Fonts.Cancel.Tip.english: Keep the fonts as they were (Escape)

Settings.SettingsSearch.Tip.english: Show only the settings whose name or note holds this (Escape clears it)
Settings.SettingsSearch.Tip.text: 仅显示名称或备注中包含此内容的设置（按Esc键可清除）

Settings.KeepSourceComments.Note.english: Off: only comments written by rules are exported.
Settings.KeepSourceComments.Note.text: 关闭：仅导出由规则生成的注释。

Settings.LineEndings.Note.english: The game's own files use LF.
Settings.LineEndings.Note.text: 游戏自身的文件使用LF分隔符。

Settings.FilesToExport.Note.english: All files: unchanged files and files with no rules are copied as they are. Slow and memory-heavy for large folders.
Settings.FilesToExport.Note.text: 所有文件：未更改的文件和没有规则的文件将原样复制。对于大型文件夹，此操作速度较慢且占用大量内存。

Settings.ArmoryMarks.Note.english: A value your mod changes has a * after it, in the heading color. Off: no *, and its tooltip still says what changed it.
Settings.ArmoryMarks.Note.text: 您模组修改过的值后面会带有 * 符号，且标题颜色会发生变化。关闭：无 * 符号，且其工具提示仍会显示修改该值的模组名称。

Settings.ArmoryFileNames.Note.english: Under each value's name in the Unit and Weapon panes, the property the game's files keep it in, such as MaxSpeedInKmph.
Settings.ArmoryFileNames.Note.text: 在“单位”和“武器”面板中，每个值名称下方显示的是游戏文件中存储该属性的名称，例如 MaxSpeedInKmph。

Settings.AskExportFolder.english: Ask for the export folder each time
Settings.AskExportFolder.text: 每次都询问导出文件夹

Settings.AskExportFolder.Note.english: Every Export asks where to write the files, starting in the folder used last. Off: each file keeps the folder chosen for it.
Settings.AskExportFolder.Note.text: 每次导出都会询问文件的保存位置，默认从上次使用的文件夹开始。关闭：每个文件保留为其选择的文件夹。

Settings.KeepFolderStructure.Note.english: Files go into the folders they were added from. Off: every file goes straight into the export folder.
Settings.KeepFolderStructure.Note.text: 文件将放入其被添加时的源文件夹中。关闭：所有文件直接放入导出文件夹。

Settings.ExportZip.Note.english: Export writes one .zip into the export folder instead of loose files.
Settings.ExportZip.Note.text: 导出时会在导出文件夹中生成一个.zip压缩包，而非单独的文件。

Settings.HoldBackFailing.english: Hold back files that fail the safety check
Settings.HoldBackFailing.text: 暂不导出未通过安全检查的文件

Settings.HoldBackFailing.Note.english: Files that aren't valid NDF, or have values that would stop mod generation, aren't written. Off: they're written anyway, with the errors on their row.
Settings.HoldBackFailing.Note.text: 不符合有效NDF规范的文件，或包含会导致模组生成失败的值的文件，将不会被写入。关闭：这些文件仍会被写入，并在其对应行中显示错误信息。

Settings.UpdateWatermarkFirst.Note.english: Before each export, opens the watermark window for every mod with a watermark. Off: only for mods set to ask.
Settings.UpdateWatermarkFirst.Note.text: 每次导出前，为每个带有水印的模组打开水印窗口。关闭：仅适用于设置为“询问”的模组。

Settings.RememberExportFolder.english: Remember this folder for these files
Settings.RememberExportFolder.text: 为这些文件记住此文件夹

Settings.RememberExportFolder.Note.english: Exported files keep the folder they went to, for the next export. Off: they keep the folder they had.
Settings.RememberExportFolder.Note.text: 导出的文件会保留其被导出的文件夹，以便下次导出。关闭：文件保留其原有的文件夹。

Settings.BackUpOverwrittenFiles.Note.english: A file an export replaces is kept beside it first, as .bak.
Settings.BackUpOverwrittenFiles.Note.text: 导出替换的文件将首先以.bak格式保存在原文件旁边。

Settings.OpenTheFolderAfter.Note.english: Opens the export folder in File Explorer when Export finishes.
Settings.OpenTheFolderAfter.Note.text: 导出完成后在“文件资源管理器”中打开导出文件夹。

Settings.EditedWithEasyNDFComment.Note.english: First line of each edited file, with the version.
Settings.EditedWithEasyNDFComment.Note.text: 每个已编辑文件的第一行，包含版本号。

Settings.StampOff.Ask.english: Without this comment, EasyNDF cannot tell whether it has already edited a file, so it cannot warn you before it edits that file a second time. Turn it off anyway?
Settings.StampOff.Ask.text: 如果没有这条注释，EasyNDF将无法判断是否已编辑过该文件，因此无法在第二次编辑该文件前向您发出警告。是否仍要关闭此功能？

Settings.AddFolderLists.Note.english: Subfolders are included. The export zip keeps the folder structure.
Settings.AddFolderLists.Note.text: 包含子文件夹。导出压缩包将保留文件夹结构。

Settings.FilesWithAPreset.english: Files a mod that is on has rules for
Settings.FilesWithAPreset.text: 已安装的模组对文件有相关规则

Settings.DuplicateFiles.Note.english: Same name and folder. Replace keeps the row's export folder.
Settings.DuplicateFiles.Note.text: 同名同文件夹。选择“替换”将保留该行的导出文件夹。

Settings.WrapTextInLists.Note.english: File, rule set and rule lists, and the edits in Details.
Settings.WrapTextInLists.Note.text: 文件、规则集和规则列表，以及“详细信息”中的编辑内容。

Settings.FolderTree.text: 以树形结构显示文件夹

Settings.FolderTree.Note.english: Group by folder shows the top folders first; each opens to its own folders and files. Off: one line per folder path.
Settings.FolderTree.Note.text: 按文件夹分组时，优先显示顶级文件夹；每个文件夹都会展开显示其下的文件夹和文件。关闭：每个文件夹路径占一行。

Settings.AutoFitFileList.text: 自动调整文件列表列宽

Settings.AutoFitFileList.Note.english: Resizing a column by hand overrides this until Reset column widths.
Settings.AutoFitFileList.Note.text: 手动调整列宽将覆盖此设置，直至执行“重置列宽”操作。

Settings.AutoAssignPresetsBy.english: Apply rule sets by file name

Settings.AutoAssignPresetsBy.Note.english: A rule set whose Applies To is "From its name" applies to the files whose whole name its name holds, capitals included. Off: rule sets apply only to the files they list.
Settings.AutoAssignPresetsBy.Note.text: “适用范围”为“根据其名称”的规则集，适用于名称（包括大写字母）与该规则集名称完全一致的文件。关闭：规则集仅适用于其列出的文件。

Settings.ReopenTheLastFiles.text: 重新打开上一次处理的文件

Settings.ReopenTheLastFiles.Note.english: When the app starts, the file list comes back as it was left. Off: the list starts empty, with Reopen Last List.
Settings.ReopenTheLastFiles.Note.text: 应用启动时，文件列表将恢复为上次关闭时的状态。关闭：列表初始为空，启用“重新打开上次列表”时除外。

Settings.UndoSteps.Note.english: How many changes to rules and the file list Ctrl+Z can take back.
Settings.UndoSteps.Note.text: Ctrl+Z可撤销的规则和文件列表修改次数。

Settings.TextSize.Note.english: Ctrl+scroll in the text changes it too.
Settings.TextSize.Note.text: 在文本中按 Ctrl+scroll 也会更改内容。

Settings.LineNumbersSwitch.Tip.english: Show line numbers beside the text

Settings.WordWrap.Note.english: Long lines wrap instead of scrolling sideways.
Settings.WordWrap.Note.text: 长行自动换行，而非横向滚动。

Settings.ScopeLines.Note.english: Thin lines down each level of indentation in the File Editor.
Settings.ScopeLines.Note.text: 在“文件编辑器”中，每缩进一层，下方会显示一条细线。

Settings.CloseBracketsAndQuotes.Note.english: Typing ( [ { " or ' also types its partner, with the cursor between them.
Settings.CloseBracketsAndQuotes.Note.text: 输入 [、{、" 或 ' 时，也会同时输入其对应的符号，光标位于两者之间。

Settings.ShowEverythingInThe.english: Show everything in the descriptor tree
Settings.ShowEverythingInThe.text: 在描述符树中显示所有内容

Settings.ShowEverythingInThe.Note.english: Off: a descriptor opens to the descriptors it names in other files, to show how files connect. On: also to its objects, lists and the descriptors it names in its own file.
Settings.ShowEverythingInThe.Note.text: 关闭：描述符会链接到其他文件中其所引用的描述符，以显示文件间的关联。开启：还会链接到其对象、列表以及自身文件中引用的描述符。

Settings.ReopenTheLastFile.Note.english: When the app starts, the files last open in the File Editor open again, side by side as they were, each where it was left.
Settings.ReopenTheLastFile.Note.text: 应用程序启动时，文件编辑器中上次打开的文件将再次打开，并像之前一样并排显示，每个文件都位于上次关闭时的位置。

Settings.Theme.Note.english: Colors and fonts. Automatic follows the system.
Settings.Theme.Note.text: 颜色和字体。自动采用系统设置。

Settings.FontsButton.Tip.english: Choose the interface font and the code font
Settings.FontsButton.Tip.text: 选择界面字体和代码字体

Settings.BeveledEdges.Note.english: Raised buttons and sunken boxes, in any theme.
Settings.BeveledEdges.Note.text: 凸起按钮和凹陷复选框，适用于任何主题。

Settings.InterfaceSize.Note.english: Makes everything in the window larger or smaller.
Settings.InterfaceSize.Note.text: 将窗口中的所有内容放大或缩小。

Settings.Tooltips.Note.english: The notes that appear when the mouse rests on a control.
Settings.Tooltips.Note.text: 将鼠标悬停在控件上时显示的提示信息。

Settings.SharpOnEveryMonitor.text: 在每台显示器上均显示清晰

Settings.SharpOnEveryMonitor.Note.english: Redraws the app for each monitor's scaling, so text stays sharp when the window moves to another monitor. Takes effect when EasyNDF restarts.
Settings.SharpOnEveryMonitor.Note.text: 根据每个显示器的缩放比例重新渲染应用程序，因此当窗口移动到另一个显示器时，文本仍保持清晰。在EasyNDF重启时生效。

Settings.RememberTheWindow.Note.english: The window opens where it was, at the size it was.
Settings.RememberTheWindow.Note.text: 窗口将以原位置和原大小重新打开。

Settings.TreadScrollbars.Note.english: A raised thumb with a grip, in a sunken track, in any theme.
Settings.TreadScrollbars.Note.text: 一个握着把手的竖起大拇指，位于凹陷的轨道中，适用于任何主题。

Settings.PanesGrowWithThe.Note.english: Details, Descriptors, the Armory's panes and the Mods tab's Mods and Rule Sets lists keep their share of the window as it is resized. Off, they keep the width they were dragged to, and only the main list or editor grows or shrinks.
Settings.PanesGrowWithThe.Note.text: “详细信息”、“描述符”、“军械库”的各面板以及“模组”选项卡中的“模组”和“规则集”列表在调整窗口大小时会保持其原有占用的窗口区域。若关闭此功能，它们将保持被拖动至的宽度，仅主列表或编辑器会随之扩大或缩小。

Settings.ColumnWidths.Note.english: Drag the line between two headings to resize. Widths are saved per table.
Settings.ColumnWidths.Note.text: 拖动两个标题之间的分隔线可调整大小。每张表格的宽度都会被保存。

Settings.ThemeDesignerButton.Tip.english: Open the Theme Designer beside the app, to make and change your own themes
Settings.ThemeDesignerButton.Tip.text: 打开应用旁边的主题设计器，以创建和修改您自己的主题

Settings.OneFileWithAll.Note.english: One file with all your mods, to keep or move to another computer.
Settings.OneFileWithAll.Note.text: 将所有模组整合到一个文件中，以便保存或转移到另一台计算机。

Settings.BackUpAllMods.Tip.english: Save all mods as one file
Settings.BackUpAllMods.Tip.text: 将所有模组保存为一个文件

Settings.RestoreBackup.Tip.english: Load a backup of all mods

Settings.ResetSettingsKeepsYour.Note.english: Reset look and layout keeps your mods, files and settings. Reset settings keeps your mods. Clear all data deletes everything EasyNDF has saved.
Settings.ResetSettingsKeepsYour.Note.text: “重置外观和布局”会保留您的模组、文件和设置。“重置设置”会保留您的模组。“清除所有数据”将删除EasyNDF保存的所有内容。

Settings.ResetLook.Tip.english: The theme, pane sizes, columns, the window and each list's view back to default. Mods, files and other settings are kept
Settings.ResetLook.Tip.text: 主题、窗格大小、列、窗口以及各列表的视图将恢复为默认设置。模组、文件及其他设置将予以保留

Settings.ResetLook.Ask.english: Reset the app's look and layout to default? EasyNDF then starts again.
Settings.ResetLook.Ask.text: 将应用的外观和布局重置为默认值？随后 EasyNDF 将重新启动。

Settings.ResetLook.ResetList.english:
The theme, and the colors kept in the color picker
Pane sizes, and which sections are folded
The Files tab's columns: widths, order, which are shown, the sort
The window's size and place, the app's size (UI scale) and fonts, the File Editor's text size
Card and table zoom in the Armory
Where Details and other panes sit (beside or below)
The view each list shows (cards or table), the Armory's sub-tab and chosen division, the Files tab's Show and Group by folder, the File Editor's filter in use, the Help page last read
Settings.ResetLook.ResetList.text:
主题，以及颜色选择器中保存的颜色
窗格大小，以及哪些部分被折叠
“文件”选项卡的列：宽度、顺序、显示哪些列、排序方式
窗口的大小和位置、应用程序的大小（UI 缩放比例）和字体，以及文件编辑器的文本大小
“军械库”中的卡片和表格缩放
“详细信息”及其他窗格的位置（旁边或下方）
各列表显示的视图（卡片或表格）、“军械库”的子选项卡和所选分区、“文件”选项卡的“显示”和“按文件夹分组”设置、文件编辑器中正在使用的筛选条件、上次阅读的帮助页面

Settings.ResetLook.KeptList.english:
Your mods and their rules
The file list and the file open in the File Editor
Export folders, the game and source folders
Your saved File Editor filters
Every other setting: exporting, the editor, the language, Undo
Settings.ResetLook.KeptList.text:
您的模组及其规则
文件列表以及“文件编辑器”中打开的文件
导出文件夹、游戏文件夹和源文件夹
您保存的“文件编辑器”过滤器
所有其他设置：导出、编辑器、语言、撤销

Settings.ResetLook.DeleteThemes.english: Also delete the themes I made
Settings.ResetLook.DeleteThemes.text: 同时删除我制作的主题

Settings.ResetSettings.Tip.text: 重置设置。模组将被保留

Settings.Designer.NewFromThisTheme.Tip.english: Make an editable copy of the current theme
Settings.Designer.NewFromThisTheme.Tip.text: 创建当前主题的可编辑副本

Settings.Designer.Reset.Tip.english: Reset the colors to the original theme
Settings.Designer.Reset.Tip.text: 将颜色重置为原始主题

Settings.Designer.Export.Tip.english: Save your theme as a file to share
Settings.Designer.Export.Tip.text: 将您的主题保存为文件以便分享

Settings.LanguageChoice.Note.english: Text a language does not cover yet shows in English. File contents and property names are never translated.
Settings.LanguageChoice.Note.text: 当前未支持的语言中的文本将显示为英文。文件内容和属性名称绝不会被翻译。

Settings.LanguagePacks.Note.english: To translate: Export, fill in each "text" in the file, then Import it.
Settings.LanguagePacks.Note.text: 翻译方法：导出时，在文件中填入每个“文本”内容，然后将其导入。

Settings.ExportLanguage.Tip.english: Save the language in use as a file to translate. For English, a blank pack
Settings.ExportLanguage.Tip.text: 将当前使用的语言保存为待翻译文件。对于英语，为空包

Settings.RemoveLanguage.Tip.english: Remove the language pack you imported for this language
Settings.RemoveLanguage.Tip.text: 删除为此语言导入的语言包

Settings.RemoveLanguage.Ask.text: 要删除您导入的{name}语言包吗？

Settings.LanguageImported.text: 已导入 {name}：{translated} 条文本，共计 {total} 条。

Settings.LanguageNotImported.english: The language pack could not be imported. {reason}

Settings.LanguageNotExported.english: The language pack could not be saved. {reason}

Settings.Designer.SearchWords.text: 主题设计器 主题 颜色 字体

Settings.CapRow.Note.english: 0 to 20000. Limits the before and after list in Details, not the edits made. 0 hides the list.
Settings.CapRow.Note.text: 0 至 20000。此范围仅限制“详细信息”中的“之前”和“之后”列表，不影响所做的编辑。0 表示隐藏该列表。

Settings.CapRow.Refused.english: Enter a whole number from 0 to 20000. Still {before}.
Settings.CapRow.Refused.text: 请输入 0 到 20000 之间的整数。仍然是{before}。

Settings.DecimalsRow.Note.english: The maximum decimal places that Add, Subtract, Multiply, Divide and Scale write into one value. 0 for no limit.
Settings.DecimalsRow.Note.text: “加”、“减”、“乘”、“除”和“缩放”操作将写入单个值的最大小数位数。0 表示无限制。

Settings.DecimalsRow.Refused.english: Enter a whole number from 0 to 12.
Settings.DecimalsRow.Refused.text: 请输入 0 到 12 之间的整数。

Settings.ThemeChoice.Automatic.english: Automatic (Paper or Slate, following the system)
Settings.ThemeChoice.Automatic.text: 自动（纸张或石板，遵循系统设置）

Settings.Backup.NoPresets.english: No rule sets to back up.

Settings.Backup.NotSaved.english: The backup could not be saved. {reason}

Settings.Reset.Ask.english: Put every setting back to how it was at first, including the theme and language? Your mods, rules and files are kept. Undo does not cover settings.
Settings.Reset.Ask.text: “是否将所有设置（包括主题和语言）恢复为初始状态？您的模组、规则和文件将被保留。撤销操作不包括设置。”；“重置设置...”

Settings.Clear.Ask.english: Delete every mod, rule set, property scan and setting EasyNDF has saved, and empty the file list? This cannot be undone. Back up your mods first if you want to keep them. Files on disk are not touched.
Settings.Clear.Ask.text: 删除EasyNDF保存的所有模组、规则集、属性扫描和设置，并清空文件列表？此操作无法撤销。若需保留模组，请先进行备份。磁盘上的文件不会被修改。

Settings.Clear.NotAll.text: 并非所有内容都能被删除。{reason}

Settings.DataNote.Folder.english: Mods, scans and settings are kept in {folder}.
Settings.DataNote.Folder.text: 模组、扫描和设置保存在{folder}中。

Settings.DataNote.InMemory.english: Mods, scans and settings are kept in memory only.
Settings.DataNote.InMemory.text: 模组、扫描和设置仅保存在内存中。

Settings.ThemeColour.Accent.text: 强调：标题、链接、高亮部分

Settings.ThemeColour.Hover.english: Item under the mouse in a dropdown or menu
Settings.ThemeColour.Hover.text: 下拉列表或菜单中鼠标悬停的选项

Settings.ThemeColour.EditorKeyword.english: Editor: keywords such as export and is
Settings.ThemeColour.EditorKeyword.text: 编辑器：关键字（如 export 和 is）

Settings.ThemeColour.EditorKeyword.Row.english: Keywords such as export and is

Settings.ThemeColour.EditorFunc.text: 编辑器：方括号前的名称

Settings.ThemeColour.EditorConst.english: Editor: constants such as True and nil
Settings.ThemeColour.EditorConst.text: 编辑器：常量（如 True 和 nil）

Settings.ThemeColour.EditorConst.Row.english: Constants such as True and nil
Settings.ThemeColour.EditorConst.Row.text: 常量，例如 True 和 nil

Settings.ThemeColour.EditorRef.text: 编辑器：引用，例如 ~/ 和 $/

Settings.ThemeColour.EditorRef.Row.text: 诸如 ~/ 和 $/ 之类的引用。

Settings.ThemeColour.ChangesAdd.text: 编辑器：仅显示更改内容，新行

Settings.ThemeColour.ChangesDel.text: 编辑器：仅显示更改，保留旧行

Settings.Designer.BuiltInNote.english: Built-in themes cannot be edited. "New from This Theme" makes an editable copy.
Settings.Designer.BuiltInNote.text: 内置主题无法编辑。“基于此主题新建”会生成一个可编辑的副本。

Settings.Designer.EditingNote.english: Editing "{name}". Changes apply and save at once.
Settings.Designer.EditingNote.text: 正在编辑“{name}”。更改将立即生效并保存。

Settings.Designer.NotAColour.english: That is not a color. Use six hex digits after a #, like #1c221e.
Settings.Designer.NotAColour.text: 这不是一种颜色。请在 # 后面使用六位十六进制数字，例如 #1c221e。

Settings.Designer.CouldNotSave.english: The theme could not be saved. {problem}

Settings.Designer.DeleteAsk.english: Delete your theme "{name}"? The app goes back to {theme}.
Settings.Designer.DeleteAsk.text: 是否要删除您的主题“{name}”？应用将恢复为 {theme}。

Settings.Designer.CouldNotDelete.english: The theme could not be deleted. {problem}

Settings.Designer.ResetAsk.english: Put every color of "{name}" back to those of {theme}?
Settings.Designer.ResetAsk.text: 将“{name}”的所有颜色恢复为{theme}的颜色吗？

Settings.Designer.Imported.english: Imported. Missing colors were taken from {theme}.
Settings.Designer.Imported.text: 已导入。缺失的颜色已从{theme}中获取。

Settings.RemoveLanguage.Off.english: Only a language pack you imported can be removed; this language comes with EasyNDF
Settings.RemoveLanguage.Off.text: “仅可删除您导入的语言包”；“此语言随EasyNDF附带”

Settings.UsageReadout.Note.english: A bar along the bottom of the window: CPU, memory, graphics card, disk and how quickly the app answers, kept up to date as you work. It measures only while it is on.
Settings.UsageReadout.Note.text: 窗口底部的状态栏：CPU、内存、显卡、磁盘以及应用程序的响应速度，在您操作过程中实时更新。仅在状态栏显示时进行监测。

Settings.UsageEvery.Note.english: How often the usage readout measures.
Settings.UsageEvery.Note.text: 使用量读数测量的频率。

Settings.KeepLog.Note.english: A file for each session, with a line for each job and what it found, each change saved to a mod, mods switched on or off, Undo and Redo, settings changed, tabs shown, errors and slow moments. For finding out what happened when.
Settings.KeepLog.Note.text: 每个会话对应一个文件，每行记录一个任务及其结果，包括保存到模组的每次更改、模组的启用或禁用、撤销和重做操作、设置变更、显示的标签页、错误及运行缓慢的时刻。用于查明何时发生了什么。

Settings.LogKeep.Note.english: How many sessions' log files are kept; the oldest goes when a new session starts.
Settings.LogKeep.Note.text: 保留多少个会话的日志文件；当新会话开始时，最旧的日志文件将被删除。

Settings.LogFiles.Note.english: The logs are kept in the data folder's Logs.
Settings.LogFiles.Note.text: 日志保存在数据文件夹的 Logs 目录中。

Settings.OpenLogFolder.Tip.english: Shows the log files in File Explorer
Settings.OpenLogFolder.Tip.text: 在文件资源管理器中显示日志文件

Units.SourceChoice.Tip.english: The game or mod whose units are shown
Units.SourceChoice.Tip.text: 显示其单位的游戏或模组

Units.Tile.Men.Tip.text: 每个单位有 {count} 名士兵

Armory.Divisions.Tip.english: A division's units, card slots and details
Armory.Divisions.Tip.text: 一个师的部队、卡位及详细信息

Units.Pane.ShowInUnits.Tip.english: Shows the unit among all the units
Units.Pane.ShowInUnits.Tip.text: 在所有单位中显示该单位

Units.ChooseSourceFirst.english: Choose a game or mod under Source to see what it has. Reading its units and pictures can take a few seconds.
Units.ChooseSourceFirst.text: 在“源”下选择一个游戏或模组，查看其内容。读取其单位和图片可能需要几秒钟。

Units.ChooseGameFolder.Tip.english: For a game Steam did not find: pick the folder with Data and Mods in it
Units.ChooseGameFolder.Tip.text: 对于 Steam 未找到的游戏：请选择包含 Data 和模组文件的文件夹

Units.NotAGameFolder.english: {folder} is not a WARNO or Steel Division 2 folder, or a mod's folder in one. Choose the game's folder: the one with Data and Mods in it.
Units.NotAGameFolder.text: {folder} 不是 WARNO 或 Steel Division 2 的文件夹，也不是其中某个模组的文件夹。请选择游戏文件夹：即包含 Data 和模组的那个文件夹。

Units.NoGame.english: No WARNO or Steel Division 2 found in your Steam libraries. Choose the game's folder: the one with Data and Mods in it.
Units.NoGame.text: 在您的 Steam 游戏库中未找到WARNO或Steel Division 2。请选择游戏文件夹：即包含“Data”和“模组”文件夹的那个。

Units.CouldNotRead.english: The units of {name} could not be read: {problem}

Units.SomeNotRead.english: Some of the source's files could not be read.

Units.Zoom.Tip.english: Zoom, kept for Cards and Table each (Ctrl+scroll, Ctrl+plus, Ctrl+minus; Ctrl+0 for 100%)
Units.Zoom.Tip.text: 缩放功能，分别适用于“卡牌”和“战局”（Ctrl+scroll、Ctrl+plus、Ctrl+minus；Ctrl+0 恢复 100% 比例）

Units.UsingWeapon.Back.Tip.english: {name}. Click to show it on the Weapons sub-tab
Units.UsingWeapon.Back.Tip.text: {name}。点击可在“武器”子选项卡中显示该内容

Units.SearchBox.Hint.english: Find a unit by name or descriptor
Units.SearchBox.Hint.text: 按名称或描述符查找单位

Units.SearchBox.Tip.english: Part of a unit's name or descriptor
Units.SearchBox.Tip.text: 单位名称或描述符的一部分

Units.OnlyInDivision.Tip.english: Hide units in no multiplayer division, which are mostly for the campaign
Units.OnlyInDivision.Tip.text: 隐藏非多人游戏师团中的单位，这些单位主要用于战役模式

Units.ModFilesNotShown.english: Some of your mod's changes aren't shown
Units.ModFilesNotShown.text: 您的模组中部分更改未显示

Units.ModFilesNotShown.Tip.english: Your mod's rules on {files} aren't shown: the copy on the Files tab isn't {source}'s own, and showing it would hide {source}'s units. Add {source}'s own copy to the Files tab to see them.
Units.ModFilesNotShown.Tip.text: 您模组针对{files}的规则未显示：文件选项卡中的副本并非{source}原生文件，显示该副本会遮盖{source}的单位。请将{source}的原生副本添加到文件选项卡中以查看这些单位。

Units.New.Stat.Armor.Tip.english: {family} armor: a whole number from {lowest} to {highest}, the levels the game's DamageResistance.ndf gives it; empty keeps the model unit's value
Units.New.Stat.Armor.Tip.text: {family}装甲：一个介于{lowest}和{highest}之间的整数，即游戏DamageResistance.ndf文件中为其设定的等级；留空则保留模型单位的原始值

Units.Check.Armor.english: {unit}: {side} armor {level} is not a level of {family} armor, which goes from {lowest} to {highest}; GenerateMod stops on it.
Units.Check.Armor.text: {unit}：{side}装甲{level}并非{family}装甲的等级，该装甲等级范围从{lowest}到{highest}；GenerateMod会在此处停止。

Units.OnlyModded.Tip.english: Show only the units vanilla {game} doesn't have: those your mod adds, and those of the game mod chosen as the source
Units.OnlyModded.Tip.text: 仅显示原版{game}中不存在的单位：即您的模组添加的单位，以及作为源文件选定的游戏模组中的单位

Units.AddUnits.Modded.Tip.english: Vanilla units are the game's own; modded units are those vanilla {game} doesn't have
Units.AddUnits.Modded.Tip.text: 原版单位是指游戏自带的单位；模组单位是指原版{game}中不存在的单位

Units.Cards.Tip.english: Cards: the units grouped by role
Units.Cards.Tip.text: 卡牌：按角色分组的单位

Units.Table.Tip.english: Table: one row a unit; click a heading to sort
Units.Table.Tip.text: 表格：每行一个单位；点击表头可排序

Units.Compare.Tip.english: Units side by side, with their weapons
Units.Compare.Tip.text: 单位并排显示，附带武器

Units.Footnote.List.english: Click a unit to see it in the Unit pane. Double-click opens it in the File Editor. Right-click for its files and new rules.
Units.Footnote.List.text: 点击一个单位可在“单位”窗格中查看其详情。双击可在“文件编辑器”中打开该单位。右键单击可查看其文件并添加新规则。

Units.Footnote.Compare.english: Green marks the best of each stat; the others show how far they are from the pinned unit (pin one from its ▾).
Units.Footnote.Compare.text: 绿色标记表示各项属性的最佳值；其余数值显示其与固定单位的差距（从其▾处开始计）。

Units.Footnote.RangeGru.english: Ranges are in the game's own units (GRU).
Units.Footnote.RangeGru.text: 距离以游戏自身的单位（GRU）为单位。

Units.Table.Sort.Tip.english: Sort by this column; click again for the other way
Units.Table.Sort.Tip.text: 按此列排序；再次点击可按相反方向排序

Units.Table.Resize.Tip.english: Drag to resize the column; double-click for its first width
Units.Table.Resize.Tip.text: 拖动可调整列宽；双击可恢复其初始宽度

Units.Pane.ClickAUnit.english: Click a unit to see it here.
Units.Pane.ClickAUnit.text: 点击一个单位即可在此处查看。

Units.Pane.ShowInEditor.Tip.english: Open the unit's descriptor in the File Editor
Units.Pane.ShowInEditor.Tip.text: 在文件编辑器中打开该单位的描述符文件

Units.Pane.NewRule.Tip.english: A new rule for this unit, in the open rule set
Units.Pane.NewRule.Tip.text: 在已打开的规则集中为该单位添加一条新规则

Units.Pane.Compare.Tip.text: 将该单位添加到“比较”中

Units.Weapons.Menu.Tip.english: Files and rules for this weapon
Units.Weapons.Menu.Tip.text: 该武器的相关文件和规则

Units.Compare.Pinned.english: Pinned: the others compare to it
Units.Compare.Pinned.text: “固定”：其他单位将与之进行比较

Units.Compare.Remove.Tip.text: 将此单位从“比较”中移除

Units.Compare.Nothing.english: Nothing to compare yet. Press + Add Units, or Compare on a unit.
Units.Compare.Nothing.text: 尚无可比较对象。请点击“+ 添加单位”，或对某个单位进行比较。

Units.Sort.Tip.english: The order the units are listed in

Units.AddUnits.Cards.Tip.english: Cards: the units as the Armory's tiles
Units.AddUnits.Cards.Tip.text: 卡片：军械库中作为图块显示的单位

Units.AddUnits.Add.Tip.text: 添加已勾选的单位（按 Enter 键）

Units.AddUnits.Add.Off.english: Tick a unit to add first
Units.AddUnits.Add.Off.text: 勾选要优先添加的单位

Units.Menu.ShowUnit.text: 在文件编辑器中显示单位

Units.Menu.ShowWeaponSet.english: Show Weapon Set in File Editor
Units.Menu.ShowWeaponSet.text: 在文件编辑器中显示武器套装

Units.Menu.ShowAmmunition.text: 在文件编辑器中显示弹药

Units.Menu.ShowMissile.text: 在文件编辑器中显示导弹

Units.Menu.NotLoaded.Tip.english: Add {file} on the Files tab to open it
Units.Menu.NotLoaded.Tip.text: 在“文件”选项卡中添加{file}以打开它

Units.Menu.NewRuleForShown.english: New Rule for the Units Shown…
Units.Menu.NewRuleForShown.text: 为所显示的单位创建新规则……

Units.Menu.ShowInWeapons.Tip.english: Shows this weapon on the Armory's Weapons sub-tab
Units.Menu.ShowInWeapons.Tip.text: 在军械库的“武器”子选项卡中显示此武器

Units.Weapon.DoubleClick.Tip.english: Double-click to see this weapon on the Weapons sub-tab; right-click for more
Units.Weapon.DoubleClick.Tip.text: 双击可在“武器”子选项卡中查看该武器；右键单击可查看更多内容

Units.Menu.NewRuleForSelected.text: 为这些单位创建新规则……

Units.Rule.ManyUnits.english: This makes one rule with {count} conditions, one for each unit. A rule this big is slow to open. Make it anyway?
Units.Rule.ManyUnits.text: 这将生成一条包含{count}个条件的规则，每个单位对应一个条件。如此庞大的规则打开速度会很慢。是否仍要创建？

Units.LeftSplit.Tip.english: Drag to widen or narrow this column; double-click for its first width
Units.LeftSplit.Tip.text: 拖动以调整此列宽度；双击恢复初始宽度

Units.OnlyInDivision.Off.english: With a division chosen, every unit shown is in a division already
Units.OnlyInDivision.Off.text: 选定一个师后，显示的所有单位都已隶属于某个师

Units.ListsSplit.Tip.english: Drag to share the height between the nations and the divisions; double-click to share it evenly
Units.ListsSplit.Tip.text: 拖动以在国家与军种之间分配高度；双击以均匀分配

Units.PanesSplit.Tip.english: Drag to share the width between the Unit and Division panes; double-click to share it evenly
Units.PanesSplit.Tip.text: 拖动以调整“单位”和“师”窗格之间的宽度；双击以均匀分配宽度

Armory.Weapons.Tip.english: Every weapon, as the units carry it
Armory.Weapons.Tip.text: 每种武器，由所属单位携带

Rules.Armory.Weapons.Tip.english: The changes made on the Armory's Weapons sub-tab
Rules.Armory.Weapons.Tip.text: 在“军械库”的“武器”子选项卡中进行的更改

Weapons.SavedIn.OtherGame.text: · 未保存：{mod} 是 {modGame} 的模组

Weapons.New.Tip.english: A weapon of your own, a copy of one you pick: every value the same until you change it, carried by no unit until you give it to some
Weapons.New.Tip.text: 你自己的武器，是你所选武器的一份副本：所有数值均保持一致，直到你进行修改；在将它分配给某个单位之前，没有任何单位携带该武器

Weapons.New.Title.english: New Weapon: Pick One to Copy
Weapons.New.Title.text: 新武器：选择一项进行复制

Weapons.New.Where.english: Your copy starts with every value of the weapon you pick
Weapons.New.Where.text: 您的副本将继承所选武器的所有属性值

Weapons.New.NotHere.english: The Armory can't add weapons to a {game} mod yet: it changes the values of the game's own weapons only.
Weapons.New.NotHere.text: 军械库目前还无法向{game}模组添加武器：它仅能修改游戏自身武器的数值。

Weapons.SearchBox.Hint.english: Find a weapon by name or descriptor
Weapons.SearchBox.Hint.text: 按名称或描述符查找武器

Weapons.SearchBox.Tip.english: Finds weapons by name or descriptor
Weapons.SearchBox.Tip.text: 按名称或描述符查找武器

Weapons.DamageChoice.Tip.english: Only weapons of this kind of damage
Weapons.DamageChoice.Tip.text: 仅限此种伤害类型的武器

Weapons.OnlyInUse.Tip.text: 隐藏没有单位携带的武器

Weapons.OnlyModded.Tip.english: Show only the weapons vanilla {game} doesn't have: those your mod adds, and those of the game mod chosen as the source
Weapons.OnlyModded.Tip.text: 仅显示原版{game}中不存在的武器：即您的模组添加的武器，以及作为源头的游戏模组中的武器

Weapons.Compare.Tip.english: Weapons side by side, measured from the pinned one
Weapons.Compare.Tip.text: 武器并排排列，以被固定的那件为基准进行测量

Weapons.Compare.Pinned.english: Pinned: the others compare to it
Weapons.Compare.Pinned.text: “固定”：其他武器将与之进行比较

Weapons.Compare.Remove.Tip.text: 将此武器从“比较”中移除

Weapons.Compare.Nothing.english: Nothing to compare yet. Right-click a weapon and choose Compare, or click Compare in the Weapon pane.
Weapons.Compare.Nothing.text: 尚无可比较的项目。右键单击武器并选择“比较”，或点击“武器”窗格中的“比较”。

Weapons.Menu.ShowUnits.text: 显示使用此武器的单位

Weapons.Delete.AskCopy.english: Delete {weapon}? It is taken out of the mod, with the copies made from it; the units given it carry the weapon it was copied from again.
Weapons.Delete.AskCopy.text: 删除{weapon}？该武器将从模组中移除，其所有副本也将一并移除；装备该武器的单位将重新装备其原始来源的武器。

Weapons.Delete.AskChanged.english: Take back your mod's changes to {weapon}? It goes back to the game's values, for every unit carrying it.
Weapons.Delete.AskChanged.text: 撤销模组对{weapon}的修改？所有装备该武器的单位将恢复为游戏默认属性。

Weapons.Delete.GameWeapon.english: {weapon} is the game's own weapon, and your mod doesn't change it: only weapons your mod adds can be deleted.
Weapons.Delete.GameWeapon.text: {weapon}是游戏自带的武器，你的模组并未对其进行修改：只有模组添加的武器才能被删除。

Weapons.Pane.Compare.Tip.english: Puts this weapon on Compare, beside the others there
Weapons.Pane.Compare.Tip.text: 将此武器添加到“比较”界面，与其他武器并列显示

Weapons.Loadout.Turret.Tip.english: A part of the unit's 3D model that turns and carries weapons; its name is the model's
Weapons.Loadout.Turret.Tip.text: 单位 3D 模型中能够旋转并搭载武器的部分；其名称即为该模型的

Weapons.Loadout.NoTurrets.english: This unit's loadout has no turrets.
Weapons.Loadout.NoTurrets.text: 该单位的装备配置中没有炮塔。

Weapons.Loadout.Add.Note.english: an ammo box of its own

Weapons.Loadout.Salvos.Tip.english: The salvos in this ammo box, which every weapon sharing it fires from (the loadout's Salves). The box holds enough shots for this many salvos of the sharing weapon with the largest salvo. A whole number from 1 to 9,999; Enter keeps it.
Weapons.Loadout.Salvos.Tip.text: 此弹药箱中的齐射弹药，所有共享该弹药箱的武器均由此发射（即装备配置中的“齐射”）。该弹药箱可容纳足够发射该共享武器最大齐射次数的弹药。1 到 9,999 之间的整数；按 Enter 键确认。

Weapons.Loadout.SharedBox.Tip.english: This weapon fires from the same ammo box as the one above it: change the box's salvos there
Weapons.Loadout.SharedBox.Tip.text: 该武器与上方武器共用同一弹药箱：请在此处修改该弹药箱的齐射设置

Weapons.Loadout.OwnBox.Tip.english: The salvos in the ammo box of its own this weapon gets. A whole number from 1 to 9,999; Enter keeps it.
Weapons.Loadout.OwnBox.Tip.text: 该武器在弹药箱中获得的齐射次数。1 到 9,999 之间的整数；按 Enter 键确认。

Weapons.Loadout.Count.Tip.english: How many of this weapon are mounted here, firing together (NbWeapons). A whole number from 1 to 99; Enter keeps it.
Weapons.Loadout.Count.Tip.text: 此处安装了多少把该武器，并同时开火（NbWeapons）。1 到 99 之间的整数；按 Enter 键确认。

Weapons.Checks.SharedBox.english: {weapons} share box {box}: each fires {shots} per salvo.
Weapons.Checks.SharedBox.text: {weapons}共享弹匣{box}：每次齐射各发射{shots}发子弹。

Weapons.Checks.SharedBoxDiffers.english: {weapons} share box {box} but fire different numbers per salvo: weapons sharing a box must fire the same.
Weapons.Checks.SharedBoxDiffers.text: {weapons}共享{box}弹匣，但每轮齐射的发射数量不同：共享同一弹匣的武器必须以相同数量齐射。

Weapons.Checks.Places.english: Every weapon is in a place the {model}'s 3D model has.
Weapons.Checks.Places.text: 每件武器都位于{model}的3D模型所处的位置。

Weapons.Checks.OtherKind.english: {weapon} in the {was}'s place: it fires with the {was}'s flash and sound.
Weapons.Checks.OtherKind.text: {weapon}取代{was}的位置：开火时带有{was}的闪光和音效。

Weapons.Checks.Added.english: {weapon} added to turret {turret}, with an ammo box of its own (box {box}).
Weapons.Checks.Added.text: {weapon} 已添加至炮塔 {turret}，并配有独立的弹药箱（box {box}）。

Weapons.Checks.Removed.english: {weapon} taken off turret {turret}: its place on the 3D model is left unused.
Weapons.Checks.Removed.text: 从炮塔 {turret} 上拆下的 {weapon}：其在 3D 模型上的位置保持空置。

Weapons.Checks.FilesMissing.english: Add to the Files tab: {files}. The changes can't be kept without them.
Weapons.Checks.FilesMissing.text: 添加到“文件”选项卡：{files}。若缺少这些文件，则无法保留更改。

Weapons.Checks.OwnCopy.english: A loadout of its own, {loadout}, copied from the {model}'s. The {model} keeps its own.
Weapons.Checks.OwnCopy.text: 拥有独立的装备配置{loadout}，该配置复制自{model}。{model}仍保留其自身的装备配置。

Weapons.Checks.OwnLoadout.english: A loadout of its own, {loadout}, copied from {from}. Other units with {from} keep it.
Weapons.Checks.OwnLoadout.text: 独立的装备配置，{loadout}，复制自 {from}。其他拥有 {from} 的单位仍保留该配置。

Weapons.Checks.NoChange.english: No changes: the unit carries {from}, as in the game.
Weapons.Checks.NoChange.text: 无改动：该单位携带{from}，与游戏中一致。

Weapons.Checks.NoChangeNew.english: No changes: the unit carries the {model}'s loadout, {from}.
Weapons.Checks.NoChangeNew.text: 无变更：该单位携带{model}的装备配置，{from}。

Weapons.Loadout.OtherKind.english: fires with the {weapon}'s flash and sound
Weapons.Loadout.OtherKind.text: 射击时带有{weapon}的闪光和音效

Weapons.Loadout.Swap.Tip.english: Another weapon in this place, keeping its turret, ammo box, flash and sound
Weapons.Loadout.Swap.Tip.text: 此位置已存在另一件武器，保留其炮塔、弹药箱、闪光效果和音效

Weapons.Loadout.CopyAndChange.Tip.english: A copy of this weapon of your own, in this place, to change on the Weapons sub-tab without changing the other units carrying it
Weapons.Loadout.CopyAndChange.Tip.text: 您在此处放置的该武器副本，可在“武器”子选项卡中进行修改，而不会影响其他装备该武器的单位

Weapons.Loadout.Remove.Tip.english: Takes this weapon off the unit.
Weapons.Loadout.Remove.Tip.text: 从该单位上卸下此武器。

Weapons.Loadout.PutBack.Tip.english: Puts the weapon back on the unit
Weapons.Loadout.PutBack.Tip.text: 将武器重新装备到单位上

Weapons.Loadout.TakeAway.Tip.english: Takes the weapon you added away again
Weapons.Loadout.TakeAway.Tip.text: 再次移除您添加的武器

Weapons.Loadout.More.Tip.english: Swap, Copy and Change…, Take Off

Weapons.Loadout.Add.Tip.english: Mounts another weapon on this turret, with an ammo box of its own.
Weapons.Loadout.Add.Tip.text: 在此炮塔上安装另一件武器，并配有独立的弹药箱。

Weapons.Loadout.RemoveAsk.english: Take {weapon} off {unit}? Its place on the unit's 3D model is left unused. You can put it back.
Weapons.Loadout.RemoveAsk.text: 要从{unit}上卸下{weapon}吗？该武器在单位3D模型上的位置将处于闲置状态。您可以将其装回。

Weapons.Loadout.NoMount.english: WeaponDescriptor.ndf on the Files tab has no such weapon in {loadout}: add the game's own copy of the file to the Files tab.
Weapons.Loadout.NoMount.text: “文件”选项卡中的 WeaponDescriptor.ndf 在 {loadout} 中没有此武器：请将游戏自身的该文件副本添加到“文件”选项卡中。

Weapons.Loadout.Missing.english: Your mod changes the weapons of a unit with the loadout {loadout}, which the Armory's source doesn't have, so its rules can't be made again. Choose the source the mod was made with.
Weapons.Loadout.Missing.text: 您的模组更改了装备{loadout}的单位武器，而军械库的源文件中不存在该装备，因此无法重新生成其规则。请选择制作该模组时所用的源文件。

Weapons.Swap.OnlyOwn.Tip.english: Shows only the weapons your mod adds
Weapons.Swap.OnlyOwn.Tip.text: 仅显示你的模组添加的武器

Weapons.Swap.Use.Tip.english: Puts the weapon picked in this place
Weapons.Swap.Use.Tip.text: 将选中的武器放置在此处

Weapons.Swap.Use.Off.english: Pick a weapon in the list first
Weapons.Swap.Use.Off.text: 请先从列表中选择一种武器

Weapons.Swap.UseCopy.Tip.english: Puts a copy of the weapon picked here, your own, to change without changing the other units carrying it
Weapons.Swap.UseCopy.Tip.text: 放置此处选定武器的副本（即你自己的），以便在不影响其他携带该武器的单位的情况下进行修改

Weapons.Swap.Cannot.Note.english: the game may not take these; you're asked first
Weapons.Swap.Cannot.Note.text: 游戏可能不接受这些设置；系统会先询问你

Weapons.Swap.Risky.english: {weapon} may not work here. {reason} The game may not take it, sometimes freezing with no message.
Weapons.Swap.Risky.text: {weapon}在此处可能无法正常工作。{reason} 游戏可能无法识别它，有时会无提示地卡死。

Weapons.Swap.Fits.Note.english: the kind the 3D model has here
Weapons.Swap.Fits.Note.text: 与该3D模型中所示的类型相同

Weapons.Swap.OtherKind.Note.english: work; fire with the {weapon}'s flash and sound
Weapons.Swap.OtherKind.Note.text: 工作；使用{weapon}的闪光和音效进行射击

Weapons.Swap.OtherKind.AddNote.english: kinds this turret doesn't carry yet
Weapons.Swap.OtherKind.AddNote.text: 该炮塔尚未配备的类型

Weapons.Swap.PickOne.english: Pick a weapon to see it here.
Weapons.Swap.PickOne.text: 选择一种武器，即可在此处查看。

Weapons.Swap.SameBox.english: Same box as the {weapons}: they fire {shots} per salvo, as this one does, so they can share it.
Weapons.Swap.SameBox.text: 与{weapons}共用同一弹药箱：它们每轮齐射发射{shots}，与该武器相同，因此可以共用弹药箱。

Weapons.Swap.Copy.Note.english: A copy is your own weapon: change its values without changing the {count} unit that carries it.|A copy is your own weapon: change its values without changing the {count} units that carry it.
Weapons.Swap.Copy.Note.text: 副本即为你的自有武器：修改其属性时，不会改变携带它的{count}个单位。

Weapons.New.Group.Note.english: your copy starts with all its values
Weapons.New.Group.Note.text: 你的副本将继承该武器的所有初始数值

Weapons.Swap.NeedsLauncher.english: A missile needs a missile launcher, which this place doesn't have.
Weapons.Swap.NeedsLauncher.text: 导弹需要导弹发射器，而此处没有。

Weapons.Swap.MustDeploy.english: It must deploy to fire, which the weapon in this place doesn't.
Weapons.Swap.MustDeploy.text: 它必须部署后才能发射，而此处的武器并不具备这一特性。

Weapons.Swap.SharedBox.english: It shares its ammo box with {weapon}, which fires {shots} a salvo: weapons sharing a box must fire the same.
Weapons.Swap.SharedBox.text: 它与{weapon}共享弹药箱，后者每轮齐射发射{shots}：共享弹药箱的武器必须发射相同数量的子弹。

Weapons.Add.NeedsLauncher.english: A missile needs a missile launcher, which this turret doesn't carry.
Weapons.Add.NeedsLauncher.text: 导弹需要导弹发射器，而该炮塔并未配备。

Weapons.Add.MustDeploy.english: It must deploy to fire, which no weapon on this turret does.
Weapons.Add.MustDeploy.text: 它必须展开才能开火，而该炮塔上的任何武器都不具备这一特性。

Weapons.Risky.MustDeploy.english: With Must deploy on, every unit carrying {weapon} must stop and deploy before firing it. {count} of them carry no other weapon that must deploy, which the game may not take, sometimes freezing with no message: {units}.
Weapons.Risky.MustDeploy.text: 启用“必须部署”选项时，每个携带{weapon}的单位在开火前必须停止并完成部署。其中{count}个单位未携带其他必须部署的武器，游戏可能无法处理这种情况，有时会导致游戏无提示卡死：{units}。

Weapons.Risky.HideForSession.english: Don't ask again during this session
Weapons.Risky.HideForSession.text: 本次会话中不要再问了

Weapons.Nation.Tip.english: Only weapons {nation}'s units carry; tick more nations to add theirs
Weapons.Nation.Tip.text: 仅限{nation}单位携带的武器；勾选更多国家以添加其武器

Weapons.Table.Tip.english: Weapons in a table, every number side by side
Weapons.Table.Tip.text: 表格中的武器，所有数字并列显示

Weapons.Footnote.english: Each card is one weapon as the game keeps it (its ammunition): every unit that carries it uses the same one.
Weapons.Footnote.text: 每张卡牌在游戏中均视为一件武器（包含其弹药）：所有携带该武器的单位均使用同一件武器。

Weapons.Footnote.Table.english: Click a heading to sort; a changed value has *
Weapons.Footnote.Table.text: 点击标题可排序；已更改的值标有 *

Weapons.NoneShown.text: 没有武器符合筛选条件。

Weapons.Column.Sort.Tip.english: Sort by this column; click again for the other way
Weapons.Column.Sort.Tip.text: 按此列排序；再次点击可切换排序方向

Weapons.Pane.ClickAWeapon.english: Click a weapon to see it here.
Weapons.Pane.ClickAWeapon.text: 点击武器可在本处查看。

Weapons.Pane.ShowInEditor.Tip.english: Open the weapon's ammunition in the File Editor
Weapons.Pane.ShowInEditor.Tip.text: 在文件编辑器中打开该武器的弹药

Weapons.Pane.ShowUnits.Tip.english: Lists only the units using this weapon, on the Units sub-tab
Weapons.Pane.ShowUnits.Tip.text: 仅列出使用该武器的单位，位于“单位”子选项卡中

Weapons.Pane.NewRule.Tip.english: A new rule for this weapon, in the open rule set
Weapons.Pane.NewRule.Tip.text: 该武器在开放规则集中的新规则

Weapons.Pane.PerSalvo.Tip.english: A whole number, at least {lowest}, the shots it fires at once. Weapons sharing an ammo box must fire the same number a salvo: the unit's loadout says when they no longer do
Weapons.Pane.PerSalvo.Tip.text: 一个整数，至少为{lowest}，表示一次发射的子弹数量。共享同一弹药箱的武器必须在同一轮齐射中发射相同数量的子弹：当不再如此时，单位装备配置中会注明

Weapons.Pane.Name.Tip.english: Your copy's name, as the Armory shows it
Weapons.Pane.Name.Tip.text: 你的副本名称，即军械库中显示的名称

Weapons.Pane.Shared.english: {units} carry it: a change here changes all of them. {copy} makes one of your own for chosen units.
Weapons.Pane.Shared.text: {units}携带该武器：此处的更改将影响所有携带该武器的单位。{copy}可为选定的单位制作一件属于你自己的武器。

Weapons.Pane.Shared.NoCopy.english: {units} carry it: a change here changes all of them.
Weapons.Pane.Shared.NoCopy.text: {units} 包含此内容：此处的更改将影响所有相关项。

Weapons.Pane.Off.NotInGame.english: {game}'s ammunition has no such value, so the Armory can't change it there.
Weapons.Pane.Off.NotInGame.text: {game} 的弹药没有此类数值，因此军械库无法在此处进行修改。

Weapons.Pane.Off.NoLevel.english: In {game}, only AP damage has a level: choose an AP kind under Damage type to give it one.
Weapons.Pane.Off.NoLevel.text: 在{game}中，只有穿甲（AP）伤害有等级：请在“伤害类型”下选择一种穿甲类型，为其设定等级。

Weapons.Pane.Copy.Tip.english: Makes a weapon of your own from this one, for the units you tick under Used By; the others keep this one
Weapons.Pane.Copy.Tip.text: 根据此武器，为你在“使用单位”下勾选的单位制作一份专属武器；其余单位仍保留此武器

Weapons.Picture.Tip.english: Gives this weapon another weapon's picture
Weapons.Picture.Tip.text: 将此武器的图片替换为另一件武器的图片

Weapons.Picture.Another.Tip.english: Pick one of the game's weapon pictures for this weapon
